14.name: The People's Militia
desc: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Highwaymen, 5 Defias Pathstalkers and 5 Defias Knuckledusters then return to him on Sentinel Hill.
objectives: Gryan Stoutmantle wants you to kill 15 Defias Highwaymen, 5 Defias Pathstalkers and 5 Defias Knuckledusters then return to him on Sentinel Hill.
details: Some Defias have eluded us. My most trusted scout reports that these Defias have been looting and pillaging the countryside, all the way into Southern Westfall. We believe they are hiding out in the Dagger Hills, plotting their next move. Slay the wretches in the name of The People's Militia.
completion: When I left the tainted lands of Lordaeron I returned to a grim state of affairs here in my homeland. But there is hope for Westfall yet. As proven by your valor in battle, it is obvious to me that you serve our cause with honor. It is with great pride that I induct thee into The People's Militia. May the Light shine upon you.

38.name: Westfall Stew
desc: Salma Saldean wants 3 Stringy Vulture Meat, 3 Goretusk Snouts, 3 Murloc Eyes, 3 Okra.
objectives: Salma Saldean wants 3 Stringy Vulture Meat, 3 Goretusk Snouts, 3 Murloc Eyes, 3 Okra.
details: Help me make some Westfall Stew! Come back with the following ingredients: $B $B 3 Stringy Vulture Meat $B 3 Goretusk Snouts $B 3 Murloc Eyes $B 3 Okra
completion: That Okra will thicken up this broth nicely! Now we just add the Stringy Vulture Meat, a few Murloc Eyes and those delicious Goretusk Snouts. And we're done! For all your help, $N, I want you to take today's first batch of Westfall Stew!

62.name: The Fargodeep Mine
desc: Explore the Fargodeep Mine, then return to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
objectives: Explore the Fargodeep Mine, then return to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
details: The mine in Northshire isn't the only one with problems! I have reports that the Fargodeep Mine in Elwynn has also become a haven for Kobolds.
BExplore the mine and confirm these reports, then return to me. The mine is almost due south of Goldshire, between the Stonefield and Maclure homesteads.
completion: This is bad news. What's next, dragons?!? We'll have to increase our patrols near that mine. Thanks for your efforts, $N. And hold a moment... I might have another task for you.

86.name: Pie for Billy
desc: Bring 4 Chunks of Boar Meat to Auntie Bernice Stonefield at the Stonefield's Farm.
objectives: Bring 4 Chunks of Boar Meat to Auntie Bernice Stonefield at the Stonefield's Farm.
details: Maybe if I got a pie, I could tell you who has that necklace. And you know, I think that old Bernice lady at that other farm makes great Pork Belly Pies...
BMaybe if you gave her some chunks of boar meat from the boars that hang around our farms, and told her what it was for, she'd bake up a pie for you.
completion: Though this wild boar meat is tough, simmer it enough and it sure does make for some tasty pie!

110.name: Insect Part Analysis
desc: Check in Gadgetzan for Alchemist Pestlezugg and his analysis of the insect parts.
objectives: Check in Gadgetzan for Alchemist Pestlezugg and his analysis of the insect parts.
details: I'm going to spend some time taking a look at Scrimshank's surveying gear... as well as putting his personal effects in order. I get the sneaking feeling behind my ears that this isn't the last loss we'll be facing against these bugs.
BI'd like for you to check in with Alchemist Pestlezugg to see if he has had a chance to process the insect parts we sent him. If they're ready, bring them to me.
completion: Yes, I have the results right here. They are... unsettling, to say the least

BOur initial suspicion that the bugs are being controlled by an outside force, we believe, is correct. If this is the case, then we are dealing with not only a very powerful unknown force, but also a malignant one. These bugs have been changed to be pure ravagers. I've never seen anything quite like it.

134.name: Ogre Thieves
desc: Return Abercrombie's Crate to Abercrombie.
objectives: Return Abercrombie's Crate to Abercrombie.
details: A few weeks ago I was picking herbs far from my house, and a band of ogres attacked me! I ran, and I was forced to leave behind a crate of precious tools and herbs.
BAfter they chased me off, the ogres swaggered back to the ogre mound in southern Duskwood. I'm sure my crate is somewhere near the mound.
BPlease, $N, retrieve this crate for me for I miss it sorely.
completion: Thank the Nec-...well, thank YOU, $N! You have more than earned your reward.
BAha! Happy! Happy nights ahead!!

158.name: Zombie Juice
desc: Speak with Tavernkeep Smitts.
objectives: Speak with Tavernkeep Smitts.
details: I need a bottle of a certain liquor - Zombie Juice. Tavernkeep Smitts at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire should have some.
BAnd please hurry, $N. These nights get cold, and I need that drink to put fire in my veins again!
completion: You need some Zombie Juice, do you? Hmm...that's some strong stuff - I don't usually get requests for it.

182.name: The Troll Cave
desc: Grelin Whitebeard would like you to kill 14 Frostmane Troll Whelps.
objectives: Grelin Whitebeard would like you to kill 14 Frostmane Troll Whelps.
details: My brother Senir and I were sent to different parts of Dun Morogh to investigate the threat posed by the trolls. The Senate has its hands full with the troggs, so they've no need for further annoyances.
BFrom what I've seen, the trolls aren't well situated here in Coldridge Valley--mostly the southern cave. I'd say that the army will not be necessary. A few strong arms should be more than enough.
BPerhaps you'd like to assist in this endeavor? I have the authority to offer compensation for your help.
completion: Argh! Those Light-blasted trolls!$B<He takes a few breaths and seems to settle down... a bit.>$BA group of them came in the night and stole my journal! I knew better than to trust that good-for-nothing appr...

206.name: Mai'Zoth
desc: Bring the Mind's Eye to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.
objectives: Bring the Mind's Eye to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.
details: Kurzen may be dead, but...that which drove him to evil still lives! Through my studies I have discovered this: An Ogre Mage - Mai'Zoth - dwells in an Ogre Mound within the eastern mountains of Stranglethorn. He is rumored to employ mind-controlling magic, and I am positive that he corrupted Kurzen.
BIf Mai'Zoth is allowed to live, then his evil may influence others, and may even cause another Kurzen to surface.
BKill him, and bring me his Mind's Eye, the artifact he uses to corrupt others.
completion: Aha! You've done it! You are a great force for good, $N, and may your strength never fade!
BI will study this Mind's Eye and determine if it may be used for good. If not... then it must be destroyed.

230.name: Sven's Camp
desc: Bring the Book from Sven's Farm to Sven.
objectives: Bring the Book from Sven's Farm to Sven.
details: Digging through the mound, you find a small, dirt-stained book.
BThe book has no title, but...it has information Sven would like to know.
completion: <Sven reads the book's pages, then slams it shut.>
BThat shadowy figure I saw was a witness to my family's death! There are questions I'd like to ask that man...if only I knew who he was!

278.name: A Dark Threat Looms
desc: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to gather Lurker Venom, a Mo'grosh Crystal, and a Crocolisk Tear.
objectives: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to gather Lurker Venom, a Mo'grosh Crystal, and a Crocolisk Tear.
details: Begin collecting the disarming materials immediately, $N. Lurker Venom can be found on the indigenous spiders in Loch Modan. Crocolisk tears are found here in the Loch as well. But a Mo'Grosh crystal will be very difficult to procure. The ogres to the northeast mine them but the crystals are a very rare commodity.
BWe need to be prepared to defuse a Dark Iron attack! Return to me once you've collected the needed items and I will prepare the mixture.
completion: Just in time, $N!

302.name: Powder to Ironband
desc: Speak with Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.
objectives: Speak with Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar.
details: If Ironband still needs blastpowder, then by Magni he'll have it! I sent the approval on ahead with a messenger to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar. He'll prepare the powder and other supplies to take to Ironband.
BAnd one more thing: I want you to personally see that the shipment of powder reaches its destination. The last one didn't, so keep your mind sharp and your eyes open.
completion: What? Stormpike wants you to personally see the shipment to Ironband?
BI... suppose that's fine, the only problem is, I've already sent Huldar with the porters, Miran and Saean. You just missed them, they left just a short while ago.

350.name: Look to an Old Friend
desc: Speak to Elling Trias in Stormwind.
objectives: Speak to Elling Trias in Stormwind.
details: That Marzon would be contacting a member of the Defias and have ties to Lescovar...

BHaving killed VanCleef and Thredd, it would be hard to see Lescovar brought to proper justice, as your evidence is nothing without their testimonies. That is not even considering the fact that Lescovar is a noble and well connected. It effectively makes him above the law.
BYou'll need other help. I loathe to do so, but there is someone I know that will aid us. You'll find Trias in the Trade District of the city.
completion: You're kidding? Shaw wants my help again? Of all the nerve...
BThe Defias Brotherhood, you say? Well, you're certainly the bearer of wonderful news, aren't you? Next you're going to tell me that Deathwing is still alive and attacking the city.
BAll right, tell me everything from the beginning. And don't leave out something you think might not be important. I need to know it all.

374.name: Proof of Demise
desc: Bring 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings to Deathguard Burgess in Brill.
objectives: Bring 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings to Deathguard Burgess in Brill.
details: Executor Zygand tells me you've been out killing Scarlet Crusaders. Tirisfal Glades is crawling with them.

BVarimathras, lieutenant to The Dark Lady, is seeing to it personally that the scum of Azeroth, the Human race, gets wiped into oblivion. Here in Tirisfal Glades we face a particularly annoying breed of humans: The Scarlet Crusade.
BVenture forth and wage an offensive on the Scarlet Crusade, $c. Bring me back 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings as proof of your loyalty to Varimathras and The Dark Lady.
completion: Varimathras would be proud. You serve your leaders well, $C.

398.name: Wanted: Maggot Eye
desc: Kill Maggot Eye and return to Executor Zygand in Brill with his paw for a reward.
objectives: Kill Maggot Eye and return to Executor Zygand in Brill with his paw for a reward.
details: Wanted: Maggot Eye!

BA foul beast, even by Gnoll standards, Maggot Eye has been sentenced to death for his crimes against The Forsaken. This despicable villain has been stealing corpses for use by the Lich King's army. Maggot Eye was last seen pillaging the lands near Garren's Haunt to the north of Brill.
BThe town of Brill hereby offers a reward to the capable soul who can carry out the execution. Show Executor Zygand the villain's paw once the deed is done.
BMercy is for the weak.
completion: Maggot Eye's dastardly acts have finally been avenged. Maybe your acts of valor will send a clear message to those who wish to bring harm to our people. On behalf of the town of Brill I thank you, $N.

422.name: Arugal's Folly
desc: Retrieve the Remedy of Arugal for Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
objectives: Retrieve the Remedy of Arugal for Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher.
details: How Arugal gained acceptance within the Kirin Tor is beyond me. His spell-casting knowledge seemed as transparent as a blown glass bauble.
BWhat's important now is learning exactly what magic Arugal used so that I can turn it against him and secure Silverpine Forest for the Dark Lady.

BArugal first stayed at the wheat farm just north of the bridge. One of the Deathstalkers reported seeing some spellbooks but could not secure them. Retrieve for me the spell labeled Remedy of Arugal from those books.
completion: This is precisely the spell I was in search of, $C. If your dedication to The Dark Lady's cause remains infallible you will find you have quite a future amongst The Forsaken.

446.name: Thule Ravenclaw
desc: Bring Bethor's Scroll to Apothecary Renferrel at the Silverpine Sepulcher.
objectives: Bring Bethor's Scroll to Apothecary Renferrel at the Silverpine Sepulcher.
details: This Ichor was crafted by an old colleague of mine: Thule Ravenclaw. He was a young, promising mage before the great war, but when the Lich King rose to power, he betrayed his brethren and allied with the Scourge.
BI did not realize he still lives, nor that he leads the Rot Hides in their forays against us!
BI know many of his spells, and can help concoct a potion to counter them. Take this scroll back to Apothecary Renferrel. It has the incantations needed for the potion.
completion: This scroll is laced with powerful magic. I've never used such forces in a potion ... it will be a powerful mixture, and should serve you well should you attack Thule in his stronghold on Fenris Isle.

470.name: Digging Through the Ooze
desc: One of the oozes at Ironbeard's Tomb has Sida's bag, retrieve it and bring it back to her in Menethil Harbor.
objectives: One of the oozes at Ironbeard's Tomb has Sida's bag, retrieve it and bring it back to her in Menethil Harbor.
details: On my weekly visit to Ironbeard's Tomb I was attacked by dreadful, dripping oozes! Naturally, I panicked.
BI threw my bag at one, but it didn't do anything! The ooze just sucked it right up... Luckily, it did give me enough time to get away.
BThe bad news is that I really need to get the contents of my bag!
BI don't know which ooze I threw my bag at; they all looked the same! Ironbeard's Tomb is northeast of here, near Dun Modr. Thank you so much!
completion: Oh, thank you, $N! I was afraid that it was lost for good!
B<She quickly empties the contents of the ooze-covered bag onto the ground, before scooping them up.>
BHm, I don't have much use for this anymore, but wash it off and I'm sure you could make use of it.

494.name: Time To Strike
desc: Travel to Tarren Mill to deliver Deathstalker Lesh's message to High Executor Darthalia.
objectives: Travel to Tarren Mill to deliver Deathstalker Lesh's message to High Executor Darthalia.
details: Be silent and pay attention, $c.

BI was sent to this position in order to survey the town of Hillsbrad. My mission is one of reconnaissance. It is imperative that you send word to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill at once. Let her know that I, Deathstalker Lesh, send the following message:
B"The raven's cry from the west doth beckon."
BFollow the road to the east and pay close attention to the signs. Now, hurry! Off you go to Tarren Mill, and with urgency I might add!
completion: The raven's cry from the west doth beckon?
BSuperb news! Hillsbrad is ripe for attack. We can carry out our plan of destruction now. Varimathras will be pleased.

518.name: The Crown of Will
desc: Kill 10 Crushridge Maulers for Melisara in Tarren Mill.
objectives: Kill 10 Crushridge Maulers for Melisara in Tarren Mill.
details: Mug'Thol and his Crushridge ogres have overrun the ruins of Alterac. It will be hard to inflict any serious punishment upon him without thinning out the ogres' numbers.
BAfter softening them up, we'll proceed.
BUnderstood? Good. Now go.
completion: The snow blooms red with the blood of the ogres, but we cannot cease our efforts until the spirit and numbers of the Crushridge have been crushed and ground into the dirt and snow.

542.name: Return to Milton
desc: Bring the Tomes of Alterac to Milton Sheaf in Stormwind.
objectives: Bring the Tomes of Alterac to Milton Sheaf in Stormwind.
details: I need to spend some time studying the Arm of Gri'lek book you brought me, though I'm sure Milton is eager to get the other recovered books into Stormwind's collection.
BHere are the books you gathered from the Ruins of Alterac, packed and catalogued. Take them back to Milton Sheaf in Stormwind and I'm sure he'll be grateful.
completion: My oh my! Look at these! I can't believe they survived the ruination of Alterac. And all those ogres too!
BThank you, $N. Thank you so much! You have helped preserve human knowledge, and you add to the grandeur of the Royal Library of Stormwind.

566.name: WANTED: Baron Vardus
desc: Kill Baron Vardus and deliver his head to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
objectives: Kill Baron Vardus and deliver his head to High Executor Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
details: By order of High Executor Darthalia, the human known as Baron Vardus is wanted for crimes against the Forsaken. Vardus is known to be a high-ranking member of the organization known as the Syndicate.
BHe was last spotted in the Uplands in the Alterac Mountains, north of Tarren Mill.
BHe is wanted dead. Bring evidence of his demise to High Executor Darthalia to claim the reward.
completion: Productive work you do, $N. With Baron Vardus dead, the number of Syndicate leaders grows smaller. Their resistance and irritation will be short-lived.

590.name: A Rogue's Deal
desc: Defeat Calvin Montague in Deathknell.
objectives: Defeat Calvin Montague in Deathknell.
details: What?
BWhat?!
BYou want money? I don't owe you any money.
BLetter? What letter? Oh, you wanna fight then? All right, mate... let's do this! Owe you any money...
completion: Incredible! What skill!
BThought you'd be easy prey, $N. Got me good, you did.
BHere's the coin I promised... not as much as I said it'd be, but that's on a count o' me lying to ya in the first place.

614.name: The Captain's Chest
desc: Bring Smotts' Chest to Hecklebury Smotts in Booty Bay.
objectives: Bring Smotts' Chest to Hecklebury Smotts in Booty Bay.
details: I used to sail a ship from here all the way to Ratchet, in Kalimdor. I was a successful captain with a sterling reputation.
BUntil...

BThose cursed sea giants ruined me! They smashed my ship, killed my crew, and set me on a lifeboat to Booty Bay. And one of the giants, Gorlash, stole my Captain's Chest. He said he wanted it for a snuffbox. The nerve!
BI hear Gorlash wanders the coast east of here. Find him and get back my chest! Do that, and you'll have earned a captain's gratitude.
completion: You found it! Oh happy day, this is! Thank you, $N. Getting back my chest cools some of the fire in me.
BBut my revenge isn't complete...

638.name: Trollbane
desc: Travel to Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands and speak with Zengu.
objectives: Travel to Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands and speak with Zengu.
details: With Thoras Trollbane dead and Stromgarde in ruins, Vol'jin has instructed that we make every effort to spirit the legendary sword Trol'kalar from the humans' hands, so that we might use it in our coming battles against the trolls of Zul'Gurub.
BZengu, one of our seasoned hunters, was dispatched to Hammerfall in northeastern Arathi Highlands to oversee its procurement.
completion: How you doing, $C? The task set before us by Vol'jin will be a difficult one, and any assistance you might provide will be appreciated and necessary.

662.name: Deep Sea Salvage
desc: First Mate Nilzlix wants you to retrieve the Charts and Logs from the Maiden's Folly and the Spirit of Silverpine.
objectives: First Mate Nilzlix wants you to retrieve the Charts and Logs from the Maiden's Folly and the Spirit of Silverpine.
details: O'Breen led the ships into the cove. We were certain this is where the treasure could be found. The Harbinger docked safely but as the Maiden's Folly and Spirit of Silverpine approached the tides began to lower. Strangest thing I've ever seen!
BThose two ships ran aground into something... some sort of temple in the reef. They sank so quickly, was quite a tragedy.
BWe need to retrieve their Logs as well as their Charts before we leave. We can't leave that information behind for prying eyes!
completion: Knowing this information is secure will bring some ease to the command in Booty Bay. Well done, $N.

686.name: A King's Tribute
desc: King Magni Bronzebeard wants you to speak with Grand Mason Marblesten.
objectives: King Magni Bronzebeard wants you to speak with Grand Mason Marblesten.
details: I do not expect good dwarves like Mrs. Balloo to understand why the travesties of war must be endured for the greater good of our people. The loss of her husband, and the loss of every dwarf that fights in the name of the Alliance, weighs heavy on my soul.
BWhile I cannot bring her husband back from the Twisting Nether, I can pay tribute to him.
BI am going to commission a memorial to Sully Balloo to be built by Grand Mason Marblesten.
BSend word to him now, $c. You shall be custodian of my bidding.
completion: So King Magni Bronzebeard himself sent ye?
BMy, my! This must be important!

710.name: Study of the Elements: Rock
desc: Find 10 Small Stone Shards and bring them to Lotwil Veriatus in the Badlands.
objectives: Find 10 Small Stone Shards and bring them to Lotwil Veriatus in the Badlands.
details: Here in the Badlands I've stopped to work on my latest project: my shackles of elemental binding.

BWhen complete, they will allow mages to summon even more powerful elementals for use in even greater capacities. To start things off, I need small stone shards to test some of my newest offensive spells along with a few gizmos I've pieced together.
BThe shards are easily collected from the lesser rock elementals to the west of here. Could you bring me some?
completion: These shall do nicely, $N. Thank you. Hmm, a bit more sand than I'd anticipated. Have to adjust the coefficient of friction. No, wait; it should still be negligible with the frost oil.
B<Mumbling to himself, Lotwil puts one fist into the palm of his other hand and stares at them as if fascinated.>

734.name: This Is Going to Be Hard
desc: Speak to Lucien Tosselwrench in the Badlands.
objectives: Speak to Lucien Tosselwrench in the Badlands.
details: Wonderful, wonderful.
B<Lotwil looks up at you for a moment before going back to his shackles.>
BGo speak to Lucien, $N. I need a cog #5. Bring it to me, will you?
completion: Cog #5, huh? Yeah, this isn't going to be good.

758.name: Thunderhorn Cleansing
desc: Use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem at the Thunderhorn Water Well, then return to Mull.
objectives: Use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem at the Thunderhorn Water Well, then return to Mull.
details: The totem is ready, $N. And again, it is your task to perform the ritual of cleansing.
BGo to the Thunderhorn Water Well, north of the village, and use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem in your ritual. After you do this, return to me.
BMay the spirits guide you.
completion: Ancestors of the Thunderhorn clan spoke to me in a dream, praising you for your actions near their well.
BFor their gratitude, they wish to give you this...

782.name: Broken Alliances
desc: Kill Boss Tho'grun and bring the Sign of the Earth to Gorn in Kargath.
objectives: Kill Boss Tho'grun and bring the Sign of the Earth to Gorn in Kargath.
details: From the Horde's alliance with the dragon Deathwing during the Second War, we know that two of his lieutenants, Blacklash and Hematus, were imprisoned within Lethlor Ravine far to the east. We must silence our depraved allies of old to restore honor to the Horde!

BWe hired Tho'grun and his band of ogre mercenaries to help us obtain the Sign of the Earth, a key needed to unlock the drakes' prison. Tho'grun betrayed us though, overwhelming us and taking it for himself. Go to Camp Boff and take it back!
completion: With Tho'grun dead, his corpse picked clean by the desert winds and scavenging buzzards, the ogres will be put into disarray. Though a small victory, this will lead to a much larger one
BThe Sign of the Earth is now in our possession, and we can open the black drakes' prison in Lethlor. We shall free them from endless imprisonment, albeit to their doom!

806.name: Dark Storms
desc: Bring Fizzle's Claw to Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.
objectives: Bring Fizzle's Claw to Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.
details: We cannot allow the Burning Blade a foothold in Durotar! We must destroy them before their evil festers!

BI have undergone my own investigations and found that a Burning Blade warlock, the goblin Fizzle Darkstorm, has camped within Thunder Ridge to the northwest. There he and his cultist minions spread chaos.
BFind and defeat Fizzle, and bring me his dead claw!
completion: Aha! You got him!
BYou do your clan proud, $N. And because of you, Durotar is free of one more agent of evil.

830.name: The Admiral's Orders
desc: Take Admiral Proudmoore's Orders to Gar'Thok in Razor Hill.
objectives: Take Admiral Proudmoore's Orders to Gar'Thok in Razor Hill.
details: You open the aged and weathered envelope and discover an official looking document. You recognize the seal of Admiral Proudmoore.
BThis looks important. Perhaps Gar'Thok, the commander of Razor Hill, would be interested in having this information.
completion: This does not bode well at all. You were wise to bring this information to my attention.

854.name: Journey to the Crossroads
desc: Speak with Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
objectives: Speak with Thork at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
details: I have foreseen your arrival, young $c. Though perhaps you are not so young anymore.
BI think that it is time for you to move deeper into this land. I can sense that you are destined for great things.

BIt is the Crossroads that you must seek out, for our lives with the orcs have become intertwined and they need assistance. Continue down this road towards the east and follow it north to the Crossroads. Find Thork within its walls, he has the Earthmother's blessing.
completion: It is good to see that more of our $R allies have come to assist us from as far away as Thunder Bluff. Again, I welcome you.

878.name: Tribes at War
desc: Kill 6 Bristleback Water Seekers, 12 Bristleback Thornweavers and 12 Bristleback Geomancers and return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
objectives: Kill 6 Bristleback Water Seekers, 12 Bristleback Thornweavers and 12 Bristleback Geomancers and return to Mangletooth at Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
details: You must strike my enemies. <snort> You must help Mangletooth and the Razormane by weakening the Bristlebacks. Both tribes are very spiritual--tied to the earth and its power. <snort> It gives us strength in all things... especially war.

BIf you want to find out who really causes Thork <snort> and the Horde such anguish, then help Mangletooth! You attack the spiritual leaders of the Bristlebacks to the north; weaken them so the Razormanes can defeat them and rule the Barrens.
completion: Yes, yes... filled with joy because finally <snort> the Bristleback know my tribe's pain, $R. That is how I should feel, but that <snort> is not the case.
BYou aid your people and they honor you. Mangletooth aids his people, and what do they do? They turn their backs on him. They forget him and leave him to rot in cage!
BI aid them even from locked behind bars and they send no one to save me!

902.name: Samophlange
desc: Return the Samophlange to Sputtervalve in Ratchet.
objectives: Return the Samophlange to Sputtervalve in Ratchet.
details: Pulling open the face of the control console reveals a dense jumble of wires, tubing and other strange mechanical objects--most of which seem to serve no practical purpose. Pushing them aside and digging deeper into the console, you find the samophlange. A tug removes it from its housing.
completion: This is... er... interesting... yes. I'll have it sent along to the Tinkers' Union headquarters in Undermine. I'm sure after some careful dissection and research, they'll be able to make some sense of it.
BBut, perhaps I'll have a little look myself first...

950.name: Return to Onu
desc: Bring Onu the recovered Insane Scribbles.
objectives: Bring Onu the recovered Insane Scribbles.
details: Peering into the Twilight Tome is maddening. Text begins to swim and dance after only a moment's glance, and once beautiful scrollwork twists into grotesque shapes.
BTearing away one page of insane scribbles is all that is possible before a swoon overtakes you.
completion: A chaotic, primal magic surrounds this parchment of scribbles. I sense the work of the old ones in it.
BLet us hope it reveals the purpose of the Twilight's Hammer in Darkshore...

974.name: Finding the Source
desc: Krakle in Un'Goro Crater wants you to find the hottest area of Fire Plume Ridge.
Whenever you find a hot spot, right click the thermometer to check the temperature. Keep looking until you find the hottest one.
objectives: Krakle in Un'Goro Crater wants you to find the hottest area of Fire Plume Ridge.
BWhenever you find a hot spot, right click the thermometer to check the temperature. Keep looking until you find the hottest one.
details: The hot springs here are a source of mystery to me. Where does the heat come from?

BLooking at how close the pools are to Fire Plume Ridge, I really wonder if the volcano might have something to do with it. I created a thermometer to take readings of the temperatures at the volcano, and I'd like to find the hottest part. It gives the measurements in degrees Kraklenheit!
BHere, take it, and take readings of the temperatures at the ridge whenever you see a hot spot!
completion: Yes, I definitely see the correlation here between the temperature of the volcano and the hot springs. I'll have to double-check my equations for accuracy, but it seems like the distance and the rate that the heat is transferred... Hmm...

1022.name: The Howling Vale
desc: Go to the Howling Vale and study the Tome of Mel'Thandris, then return to Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow at Forest Song.
objectives: Go to the Howling Vale and study the Tome of Mel'Thandris, then return to Sentinel Melyria Frostshadow at Forest Song.
details: Though we have put many resources and much effort into driving the remaining demons from the Felwood to the north, our successes have been few. We have been able to keep much of the demonic presence from Ashenvale.

BTo the north, near the Felwood border, the ruined shrine of Mel'Thandris has been overtaken by mysterious wolf-men. Their chilling calls have led the area to be known as the Howling Vale. The Tome of Mel'Thandris kept at the shrine may shed some light on why these wolf-men have come.
completion: The Tome of Mel'Thandris works in strange ways. The events it records, the events it shows... No one truly understands why it does what it does.
BNonetheless, it is clear that what Priestess Starsong received--this Scythe of Elune--bears further investigation.

1046.name: Raene's Cleansing
desc: Bring Ran Bloodtooth's Skull and Dartol's Rod of Transformation to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.
objectives: Bring Ran Bloodtooth's Skull and Dartol's Rod of Transformation to Raene Wolfrunner in Astranaar.
details: Return to your own tribe and let them know of your victory here.
BShow them your trophy, and bask in the glory...
completion: So, this is the skull of the fiercest furbolg threat in Ashenvale?
BI am more than pleased with your abilities, $N. The Sentinels cannot thank you enough. I hope we can rely on you again in the future to help our people.
BI shall put this skull and Dartol's Rod in a place of reverence for others to see.
BTeronis would be proud. Thank you again.

1070.name: On Guard in Stonetalon
desc: Find Kaela Shadowspear overlooking the valley entering Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains.
objectives: Find Kaela Shadowspear overlooking the valley entering Windshear Crag in the Stonetalon Mountains.
details: Hello, $N.
BYou seem to be full of wanderlust by the looks of you. Have you been to the Stonetalon Mountains? It is a land plagued by the Venture Co. and other enemies of the night elves.

BRecently, Sentinel Wolfrunner sent my friend Kaela Shadowspear there to investigate what's happening to the land, but I have yet to hear word back from her. I'm even more concerned because the Alliance sent a gnome mage along with her... a sign of trouble for sure.
BWould you find her and report back to me?
completion: Ah, you've come from Ashenvale at the behest of Thenysil -- how I miss her, my homeland and friends. She must be doing well with the Sentinels to be sequestering adventurers for other tasks. I'm proud of her.
BIt is a pleasure to meet you, $N.

1094.name: Further Instructions
desc: Deliver the Sealed Envelope to Sputtervalve in the Barrens.
objectives: Deliver the Sealed Envelope to Sputtervalve in the Barrens.
details: This envelope has all the information I was able to snatch as they booted me out the door... Venture Company internal documents, some manuals, technical things... Oh, and of course the Super Reaper 6000 blueprints.
BSputtervalve has taken up residence at Ratchet in the Barrens. Shouldn't have much trouble finding him, he's a little green fellow.
completion: Fizziks, eh? Can't say I trust him, but this information seems good enough. What I wouldn't give to have the Venture Company out of my hair.
BThey do come up with some good machines though... I can't deny that we've benefited from using some of the improvements they've devised.

1118.name: Back to Booty Bay
desc: Bring Kravel's Scheme to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
objectives: Bring Kravel's Scheme to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
details: $N, you're a $c I can trust, both to get the job done and to keep your mouth shut while doing it.
BI've been brewing up a new scheme. It's risky, but if it works then we could both make a bundle! And I think you're just the person to see it through.
BTo start, you must go back to Booty Bay. I apologize, good $N. I know my last task took you there. But this time, speak with Crank Fizzlebub.
BGive him this letter. And if he requires aid, do your best to help him. It will be worth the effort.
completion: I see. Kravel has a big scheme planned. He has a sinister mind -- I like that about him.
BSo you'll need something to addle wits, eh? Something powerful...
BI wonder if the mixture Zanzil feeds his zombies could be used...

1142.name: Mortality Wanes
desc: Find and return Treshala's Pendant to Treshala Fallowbrook in Darnassus.
objectives: Find and return Treshala's Pendant to Treshala Fallowbrook in Darnassus.
details: I have not long to live... so... so... weak.
B...the b-b-brave dwarf, Lonebrow, has been sent to w-w-warn Falfindel...
BBut before I... d-d-die...
B...my wife, Treshala... her pendant of bonding to me... stolen... by one of the f-f-foul aggressors...
BFind it p-p-please... and return it to Treshala in Darnassus...
B...along with w-w-word of my lonely... death.
completion: No!
B'Tis not fair. Oh, cruel and intolerable world!
BI must now carry this burden of grief and not let Heralath's work die with him.
BYou were brave to journey from such a dangerous place, $N. But please leave me now.
BIn solitude I shall mourn.

1166.name: Overlord Mok'Morokk's Concern
desc: Overlord Mok'Morokk in Brackenwall Village wants you to retrieve his grog, snuff and strongbox in Dustwallow Swamp.
objectives: Overlord Mok'Morokk in Brackenwall Village wants you to retrieve his grog, snuff and strongbox in Dustwallow Swamp.
details: Bow before Overlord Mok'Morokk!
BRexxar make me mighty leader of Stonemaul Clan!
BMe good leader. Me keep clan safe.
BBig dragons come and make fire at old home. Me smart ogre. Find new home for clan here.

BLeave old home so fast, me forget stuff. Tiny $r, go get my things. Go south and find my yummy grog, my snuff and my strongbox. Me like you after you do that. You look in Den of Flame and Stonemaul Ruins... they be there, me sure!
completion: You good $r. Me miss things very much. Me like you now.

1190.name: Keeping Pace
desc: Have Zamek create a diversion, then steal Rizzle's plans for Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats.
objectives: Have Zamek create a diversion, then steal Rizzle's plans for Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats.
details: The Brassbolts brothers have discovered a new building material, that's the only explanation that makes sense. Their cars have been operating faster than before, but their designs, and all the other data we've gathered from their runs is identical.
BWhat we do know, is that Rizzle Brassbolts has been focused on the plans for this new discovery almost constantly.
BZamek can create a diversion for you, so that you can steal those plans from them.
completion: Scribbled in a hasty, hurried hand, a scroll of notes and designs for the refinement of some raw material.

1238.name: The Lost Report
desc: Bring the Spy's Report to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
objectives: Bring the Spy's Report to Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village.
details: Sifting through the loose dirt, the severed hand of an orc is found. And clutched in the hand is a bone-carved tube. And in the tube is a dirt-stained parchment.
BThe parchment is a report made by an orc who spent weeks spying on the city of Theramore.
BAfter scanning the parchment, it is clear that it must be brought to the orc spymaster in Brackenwall Village.
completion: Good work, $N. Our agent, Marg Nighteye, was stationed outside Theramore. He was charged to spy on the city.
BThis is his latest report, and it may be his last -- from your testimony, I fear that Marg met his end in the swamp...

1262.name: Report to Zor
desc: Bring the Jeweled Pendant to Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring the Jeweled Pendant to Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar.
details: It is strange that the pendant Marg stole was in the hands of common soldiers. Perhaps its owner was in disguise, or perhaps the soldiers themselves stole it!
BRegardless of which is true, this is a noble's pendant and we must discover its true owner if we are to unravel its mystery.
BTake the pendant to Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar. He is well schooled in Alliance politics, and will know if this pendant has a history among the nobles of Stormwind.
completion: This pendant was crafted with great skill and precision, $N. No orc would covet such a jewel...
BBut many humans would.
BI will have this pendant studied. In time let us hope that its mysteries will be revealed to us.

1286.name: The Deserters
desc: Get information about Reethe from Balos Jacken and the deserters in Dustwallow Marsh.
objectives: Get information about Reethe from Balos Jacken and the deserters in Dustwallow Marsh.
details: It has been a struggle maintaining a presence in the marsh, but through strength of our resolve, we have been able to maintain several defensive watchtowers throughout the area.
BThe latest information and scouting reports I have received indicate that a group of deserters has squatted in our abandoned tower at Lost Point, southeast of the inn.
BThe local lieutenant seems to be Balos Jacken. See if you can get some information out of him.
BBe warned, $n. He may be a tough nut to crack.
completion: Did Vimes send you? Couldn't do his dirty work himself, could he...

1358.name: Sample for Helbrim
desc: Bring the Wolf Heart Sample to Apothecary Helbrim in the Barrens.
objectives: Bring the Wolf Heart Sample to Apothecary Helbrim in the Barrens.
details: A colleague in Kalimdor, Apothecary Helbrim, is researching the effects of Lordaeron toxins on the beasts of Kalimdor. He would be very interested in a sample of the wolf hearts Renferrel sent me.

BHelbrim is stationed in the Barrens, in a village known as the Crossroads. To reach him, you must travel via zeppelin to the orc capital of Orgrimmar, then travel south, by foot, to Durotar. Head west into the Barrens, and you will soon reach the Crossroads.
completion: Ah, very good. If initial reports are true, then the toxicity of these hearts could lead to further advances in our knowledge of poisons.
BThis is a welcome delivery, $N. Your reward is well earned.

1382.name: Strange Alliance
desc: Gain a Friendly reputation with the Gelkis, then speak with Uthek the Wise.
objectives: Gain a Friendly reputation with the Gelkis, then speak with Uthek the Wise.
details: We are fortunate the centaur clans fight among themselves, for if they joined into a single force then they would be unstoppable. Yes, we are fortunate, and we should press our advantage.
BOne of the centaur clans, the Gelkis clan, is in brutal war with the Magram clan. If we attack the Magram, then perhaps an alliance may be struck with the Gelkis.
BSpeak with Uthek the Wise, in the outskirts of the Gelkis camps in southwestern Desolace. Through her we might strike an alliance with the Gelkis.
completion: Your name is whispered among the Gelkis. You have much Magram blood on your hands. This is good.
BMaybe it is also good if we speak. Speak of what you can do for the Gelkis, and what we can do for you.

1430.name: Fresh Meat
desc: Bring 10 Monstrous Crawler Legs to Dar in the Swamp of Sorrows.
objectives: Bring 10 Monstrous Crawler Legs to Dar in the Swamp of Sorrows.
details: There's a high demand for the succulent taste of crawler meat among my customers; especially the meat from the monstrous crawlers.
BIf you plan on heading to the coast, then I could easily make it worth your while to bring me back some of their legs to have transported back to Orgrimmar.
BThe coast is to the east from here, and you should have no problem finding the creatures scurrying along the beaches and under the sea.
completion: Ah, this should be perfect. I can't wait to taste these after they are prepared perfectly over an open fire. You should take a sample of it with you on your travels. It truly is delicious.

1454.name: The Karnitol Shipwreck
desc: Find Karnitol's Chest in Desolace.
objectives: Find Karnitol's Chest in Desolace.
details: My first order of business is for the mage Karnitol--a noble of some sort in Stormwind. Seems his ship was attacked by sea giants while off the coast in the northwest of Desolace. He and his servants tried to bring one of his more valuable chests ashore, but when the sea giants attacked in droves, he chose to abandon it and teleport himself and his servants to safety.
BHe wants us to find the chest and its contents, and return it to him in Stormwind.
completion: You notice the chest does not seem to have any water damage.

BThe second thing you notice is that the top has been forced open, and whatever magical traps were set to safeguard it have long been triggered--this much is obvious from the burn marks around its edges.

1478.name: Halgar's Summons
desc: Speak with Carendin Halgar in the Undercity.
objectives: Speak with Carendin Halgar in the Undercity.
details: Ah, $n! I just received word from Carendin Halgar that he would like to see you for further training.
BYou should be proud of yourself, $n. It's not every day that Master Halgar personally sees fit to instruct a young warlock.
BYou'll be able to find him in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, near the Temple of the Damned.
completion: Good, I see Ageron managed to find you, $N. Let us waste little time with small talk and pleasantries and focus on your training. There is still much you have to learn.

1502.name: Thun'grim Firegaze
desc: Speak with Thun'grim Firegaze in the Barrens.
objectives: Speak with Thun'grim Firegaze in the Barrens.
details: It is vital that a warrior's weapon is one of quality. And if there is an orc who can craft quality weapons, then that orc is Thun'grim Firegaze. He is a hermit who dwells atop the hills east of the Crossroads.
BIf you seek a weapon, warrior, then you should seek Thun'grim. To find him, first travel to the Crossroads to the west, then strike east into the hills. His camp is high on a hilltop.
completion: My eyes have long dried out from staring into the forge's flame, but some things I can still see. I can see you want something.
BAnd if you found your way here, then I can guess what you desire.

1526.name: Call of Fire
desc: Defeat the Minor Manifestation of Fire, and place the Glowing Ember in the brazier atop the Shrine of Eternal Flame.
objectives: Defeat the Minor Manifestation of Fire, and place the Glowing Ember in the brazier atop the Shrine of Eternal Flame.
details: The fire sapta is finished. The time has come for you to face the flame. Use the sapta at the shrine and head to the top of the mountain to face the manifestation there. He will not attack until you are ready, but he will realize you are able to see him.
BStrike him down swiftly, $N, for he shall only grow in power the longer you take to slay him. Once he is defeated, place his glowing embers within the brazier and light the torch.
completion: A white hot flame ignites within the bowl as you place the ember within. You can feel the magical effects of the sapta coursing through your body and the fire dances rhythmically before you.
BYou place the top of the torch within the basin, and it immediately catches on fire.

1598.name: The Stolen Tome
desc: Retrieve the Powers of the Void for Drusilla La Salle.
objectives: Retrieve the Powers of the Void for Drusilla La Salle.
details: You there! $n, right?
BI hope you're sure about becoming a warlock, because if you can't hold your own, you're likely to get pulled under.
BI'm to teach you, but I need to make sure you're strong enough first.
BThere was a novice studying at the Abbey who ran off to join the Defias Brotherhood. Why do I care? Well, he stole some important books.
BOne of those happens to be a book I've wanted for myself, the Powers of the Void. Steal it for me, they have it hidden at their tent in the Vineyards.
completion: Excellent... I was never able to gain access to this text, it was held in a protected wing of the library that would have looked suspicious for me to be loitering around.
BWell, you did a good job in getting this, and I'm convinced that you can probably handle your own imp, so there's no reason for me not to show you how to summon one.

1646.name: The Tome of Divinity
desc: Speak to Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge.
objectives: Speak to Tiza Battleforge in Ironforge.
details: In all things, a paladin must reflect the Light which supplements our strength. To strive to be divine for one of our kind does not mean we strive for godhood--we strive to be good in all actions.

BAlthough called upon to smite evil in these harsh times, you must always remember that it's aiding others that will truly set you apart from the citizens of Azeroth. Compassion, patience, bravery--these things mean as much to a paladin as strength in battle.
BKnow this well, and never forget it.
completion: Welcome back, $N. You've spent time reading the book, I hope?

BThen you should be prepared to have yourself tested. There are always tasks to be done throughout the city and our lands; acts of compassion and understanding; people who need help; creatures to slay.
BBy proving you have the patience to help others, especially those who are less fortunate, you prove that you are a servant of the Light and of sound mind.

1718.name: The Islander
desc: Speak with Klannoc Macleod.
objectives: Speak with Klannoc Macleod.
details: Your renown as a warrior grows, $N. Now it is time to pit yourself against your peers and see where you stand.
BThere is an island off the coast of the Barrens, south of Ratchet. It is called Fray Island and it is a place where warriors meet.
BMeet, and fight.
BSpeak with the chief warrior of Fray Island, Klannoc Macleod. If he finds you worthy, then Klannoc will lead you further down the warrior's path.
BTo reach Fray Island, search for the sand bar shallows along the Merchant Coast.
completion: Hello, $N. It's good to see you made it to Fray Island. I hope you find it to your liking...

1838.name: Brutal Armor
desc: Bring to Thun'grim Firegaze 15 Smoky Iron Ingots, 10 Powdered Azurite, 10 Iron Bars and a Vial of Phlogiston.
objectives: Bring to Thun'grim Firegaze 15 Smoky Iron Ingots, 10 Powdered Azurite, 10 Iron Bars and a Vial of Phlogiston.
details: I have heard tales of your strength and valor, and wish to make for you a suit of armor, a companion to aid you as tales of your great deeds grow.
BBut the fashioning of this armor will be a quest unto itself, $N. I will need your help, and the help of other smiths of the Horde.

BHere, take this scroll. I spent many nights, struggling with near-blind eyes, writing that which I need for the armor. Bring me the items on this scroll and I will create for you the first piece of the suit.
completion: You brought all that I asked. Now, I will do my part...

1886.name: The Deathstalkers
desc: Get Astor's Letter of Introduction and return it to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter.
objectives: Get Astor's Letter of Introduction and return it to Mennet Carkad in the Rogues' Quarter.
details: If you wish to join the Deathstalkers, Lord Varimathras' elite guard, you will have to prove your worth.
BI will not lie to you, $n, this task could mean your death.

BI have some things that need attending to. I require the personal effects of Astor Hadren, a messenger who travels between Silverpine and the Undercity. I will leave the method of procurement to your discretion.
BIt will be better for you if you know less of the nature of this business. Succeed and I shall tell you more.
completion: Well done, $N. You've passed the first part of this test. Hopefully Andron will not have caught wind of your activities, and we will be able to convince him that you are, in fact, the messenger he is expecting.

1958.name: Celestial Power
completion: You should be proud of yourself, $N. Many mages have fallen to the creatures you faced.
BThe Celestial Orb is ready. Or if you'd like I can mount it atop a staff. It's up to you. I'd prefer the orb, but who am I to judge?

2078.name: Gyromast's Revenge
desc: Find Gelkak's First Mate, the Threshwackonator 4100, and lead it back to Gelkak.
objectives: Find Gelkak's First Mate, the Threshwackonator 4100, and lead it back to Gelkak.
details: Landlubber, ye needs to find me first mate.
BTake this'n key, puts it in his gulliver an' bring him back here to serve the Cap'n.
BThem murlocs an' their chief ain't gonna be too happy once me first mate gets a hold of em!
completion: Yarrr... Ye be provin' yerself to be more than a yella sea dog, landlubber.
BThe Cap'n may promote ye to poop deck swabby if ye be keepin' this up...

2198.name: The Shattered Necklace
desc: Search for the original creator of the shattered necklace to learn of its potential value.
objectives: Search for the original creator of the shattered necklace to learn of its potential value.
details: You have found a tarnished necklace, though the tarnish belies intricate and magical craftsmanship. The necklace has been shattered, as its setting appears to be missing three gems. On the underside of the necklace is the faint imprint of the city seal for Ironforge. Below the seal are three tiny, engraved letters: "TdK".
BIf there is anything to be gleaned from the necklace, you will need to learn about its origins. Perhaps the seal and the initials are a start...
completion: Yes... I am the jeweler who made this necklace. I also am not in the business of handing out information as though it were free. Information is never free, friend. If I am going to help you out, you need to help ME out first.

2318.name: Translating the Journal
desc: Find someone who can translate the paladin's journal. The closest location that might have someone is Kargath, in the Badlands.
objectives: Find someone who can translate the paladin's journal. The closest location that might have someone is Kargath, in the Badlands.
details: At an impasse of sorts, you know that you will need the book translated into a language you can understand. There certainly are a number of people in the world who could do it; the closest location that might have someone who could, however, is the Kargath outpost in the Badlands. Perhaps that is a good place to start.$B
completion: Mighty $C, I know what you are doing out here in the Badlands. I know you seek my gift of tongues. You're after the parts to that necklace you found in Uldaman.
BSurprised? Don't be - it's my job to know such things. Instead, let's discuss what you're going to do for a translated journal. Trust me - I'm the only one you'll find that can translate it.
BBetter still, let me make you a better offer than Dran Droffers is, and it'll let you still complete your deal with them. Interested now, yes?

2342.name: Reclaimed Treasures
desc: Get Patrick Garrett's family treasure from their family chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman, and bring it to him in the Undercity.
objectives: Get Patrick Garrett's family treasure from their family chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman, and bring it to him in the Undercity.
details: Sweeping the bat pens with this broom is not befitting a Garrett! I've earned a little coin from this accursed job, and I'm willing to spend it on you to better my station.

BThe Garrett family weapon of choice is locked away in our chest in the South Common Hall of Uldaman from when we Garretts toiled there as diggers. Without it, I will be stuck here forever - literally - sweeping up after these infernal bats.
BReclaim my family's treasure and bring it to me! Help me restore my birthright!
completion: At last - a broom worthy of a Garrett. You're bloody well worth every silver I spent on you, I say!
BDo you hear me, foul bats? I now wield the Garrett family weapon of choice! Tremble, bats, tremble!!

2438.name: The Emerald Dreamcatcher
desc: Bring the Emerald Dreamcatcher to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.
objectives: Bring the Emerald Dreamcatcher to Tallonkai Swiftroot in Dolanaar.
details: I was once given an emerald dreamcatcher from Gaerolas Talvethen, the warden of the druids in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. This powerful amulet is able to siphon energy from the Emerald Dream, bestowing luck upon those who carry it.

BSadly, I have not been able to retrieve it from my dresser in Starbreeze Village... Although Starbreeze was once a tranquil place, it has now succumbed to the corruption of the furbolg that reside there.
BPerhaps you would be willing to recover my dreamcatcher, $c?
completion: My emerald dreamcatcher is of great importance to me. It is a gift only given to few. Thank you for returning it, $N.

2582.name: Rage of Ages
desc: Bring three Snickerfang Jowls, two Blasted Boar Lungs, and one Scorpok Pincer to Bloodmage Drazial.

2606.name: In Good Taste
desc: Marin Noggenfogger wants you to speak with Sprinkle in Gadgetzan.
objectives: Marin Noggenfogger wants you to speak with Sprinkle in Gadgetzan.
details: Blech! This stuff tastes terrible! So much for that idea...
BWait, what's that? Oh, I know, I know, you think I shouldn't give up on this stuff. Well, okay then.
BUhhhh, I have an idea! Brilliant! Take this dew to my friend Sprinkle -- she's an excellent chef. Tell her what we're up to here and that we want to make it go down a little easier.
BI mean, if it's going to taste that bad, it at least should have some kick to it... And I'm just not feeling it...
completion: Marin's a good guy, don't get me wrong -- just a little... eccentric, I'd say.
BAnd of course he needs my help, yet again.

2702.name: Heroes of Old
desc: Speak to Corporal Thund Splithoof.
objectives: Speak to Corporal Thund Splithoof.
details: You have honored me with your nobility and heroism, $N.
BYou have also honored them...
completion: Indeed, you have honored us all. Our thanks alone are not sufficient.

2822.name: The Mark of Quality
desc: Bring 10 Thick Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
objectives: Bring 10 Thick Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache.
details: I take pride in my leather work, and I feel it shows; quality should never be compromised. Anyone who says that quality doesn't matter would also have you believe that the earth does not keep secrets!

BIn my latest pursuit of high-quality materials, I have discovered thick yeti hides. Yetis are native to Feralas, often found west of here in Feral Scar Vale. I'll give you a choice of one of my leather goods for a stack of ten. If that is agreeable to you, then we are set!
completion: Ah, excellent! These hides, when given a special treatment, are as resilient as iron I tell you! It will take many tries in order to get the right mix down for the tanning, but I am confident they will bring my mark of quality to the next level.
BAs for you, $N... your assistance has proven invaluable to me. Please take your choice from these items I have crafted.

2846.name: Tiara of the Deep
desc: Bring the Tiara of the Deep to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.
objectives: Bring the Tiara of the Deep to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.
details: Long ago I possessed a beautiful piece of jewelry, the Tiara of the Deep. And not only was it pretty--it held great power for those with the knowledge to use it.
BSo when word of the tiara reached the Hydromancer Velratha, she had to have it. She sent agents to my home and they stole it while I was away. The thieves!
BI want my tiara back! Go to Zul'Farrak, the troll city in Tanaris, find Velratha and wrench the tiara from her. Return it to me and you'll earn my favor.
completion: Wonderful! You found it! And what's just as important--Velratha no longer has it! Thank you, $N. I am forever in your debt!
BAnd if I sounded a little... mean before, pay it no mind. You'll find me a much nicer person to those who haven't stolen from me.

2870.name: Against Lord Shalzaru
desc: Eliminate Lord Shalzaru, and then bring the Mysterious Relic he uncovered to Latronicus Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.
objectives: Eliminate Lord Shalzaru, and then bring the Mysterious Relic he uncovered to Latronicus Moonspear in Feathermoon Stronghold.
details: $n, new scouting reports have given us a good idea on the naga chain of command. Royalty is present amongst their rank and file, and they're the ones calling all the shots.

BSpecifically, we've identified one of the crueler royals as Lord Shalzaru. Scouts report that he himself has uncovered an odd relic during a recent naga excavation in a cave south of the main ruins, across the water on the Isle of Dread.
BPut a stop to it by putting a stop to him, and bring me his relic so we can study it.
completion: Well played, $N! Lord Shalzaru's demise will throw the naga into disarray for some time, if not permanently. The threat they pose is now under more of our control than it has ever been, and we have you to thank for it.
BHere is more bounty money from the stronghold treasury - you've earned every copper. You and yours are welcome in Feathermoon Stronghold anytime, my friend.
BOne more thing before you depart, $N... if you could...

2942.name: The Morrow Stone
desc: Return the Sparkling Stone and the Stave of Equinex to Troyas Moonbreeze in Feathermoon Stronghold.
objectives: Return the Sparkling Stone and the Stave of Equinex to Troyas Moonbreeze in Feathermoon Stronghold.
details: The moment the artifact is removed from the Monolith, you feel the energy in the Stave of Equinex begin to fade.
completion: I have been reading since you left, $N. This stone you have found is called the Morrow Stone. While I am not entirely sure what its purpose is yet, you can be sure that it is something of great significance to be hidden away inside the Equinex Monolith the way it was.
BI will continue my studies, and I hope I will be able to count on you in the future, $N. Thank you for all your help.

2966.name: Seeing What Happens
desc: Bring the miniature platinum discs to the gates of Uldum in Tanaris and look for clues as to the connection between the two.
objectives: Bring the miniature platinum discs to the gates of Uldum in Tanaris and look for clues as to the connection between the two.
details: Sage Truthseeker and I would like you to take the miniature discs you found to the sealed gates of Uldum. We... we aren't sure what will happen when you do this.

BThis sounds risky, sure, we acknowledge that. It might, however, do nothing. You might need to use the discs on something. Perhaps the doors unlock when you have the discs in your possession. Be open to try anything, and be ready for anything to happen.
BLearn what you can, then return to me. We will have much to discuss.
completion: As you touch the pedestal, the miniature discs from Uldaman hum and glow in your backpack. A familiar feeling tingle washes over your hands, as the image of another Stone Watcher springs to life in front of the gates of Uldum.

B"Salutations. I am a guardian of entry. The discs that have been used for access are missing the correct entry discs, the Plates of Uldum. Please incorporate these plates with the disc structure and repeat your access sequencing. Thank you."

2990.name: Thadius Grimshade
desc: Bring Sharpbeak's Feather to Thadius Grimshade in the Blasted Lands.
objectives: Bring Sharpbeak's Feather to Thadius Grimshade in the Blasted Lands.
details: Take this feather to Thadius Grimshade, the diviner. He left Aerie Peak years ago to pursue darker knowledge, but in his heart he is still a Wildhammer!
BAnd perhaps his talents can help us find Sharpbeak.
BThis feather was taken from the nest where the gryphon child sleeps. If you give it to Thadius then, with luck, he can use his divining magics to find Sharpbeak.
BGood luck, $N. You will find Thadius in the Blasted Lands, in the mage tower of Nethergarde Keep.
completion: Ah, yes. This feather belongs to a fine gryphon. One destined for great things... if he can survive into adulthood undamaged.
BYou wish to find him? Then listen close, brave $C...

3062.name: Dark Heart
desc: Talo Thornhoof in Camp Mojache wants Edana Hatetalon's Dark Heart.
objectives: Talo Thornhoof in Camp Mojache wants Edana Hatetalon's Dark Heart.
details: Edana Hatetalon is the queen of the Northspring harpies that reside in the ruins to the west. She is pure evil; I have heard that her heart is one of crystal. She is void of any emotion aside from the hate she feels towards all others. You must face Edana and bring me back her dark heart.
BI have heard of a horn that harpies carry -- blowing it by the Hatetalon stones, in the northern part of the ruins, will summon the queen.
BImagine her surprise when it is not her kin calling her, but her death.
completion: Now I know that Edana is truly dead. This heart; I will keep it in memory of what did here for me, $N. Thank you.

3086.name: Glyphic Tablet
desc: Read the Glyphic Tablet and speak with Mai'ah near the entrance to the Den in the Valley of Trials.
objectives: Read the Glyphic Tablet and speak with Mai'ah near the entrance to the Den in the Valley of Trials.
details: Ah, while you were gone a tablet came for you, $N.
BRead it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Mai'ah. She would have words with you when you're ready.
completion: You be among da most powerful beings on da planet, $N... there no arguin' dat. And everyone know it... know it good, too!

BBut ya must be weary! 'cause it not orc, or elf, or dwarf dat you should be scared of... it be da tings you can'na see. Magic be powerful. Make you do tings you may not want to do. Make ya tink you more powerful then you really be. Be patient. Be smart.
BWhen ya tink you be ready for trainin', come back to Mai'ah. She teach you what you ready to learn, no problem.

3110.name: Hallowed Rune
desc: Read the Hallowed Rune and speak to Branstock Khalder in Anvilmar.
objectives: Read the Hallowed Rune and speak to Branstock Khalder in Anvilmar.
details: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the priest trainer Branstock. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
completion: I'm the one who can train ya as you start to find your way around Coldridge Valley. When ya feel yer ready, come back to me and we'll see about maybe teaching you a new spell or two to fend off the valley from them blasted troggs.
BYa got the Light on yer side, along with all of Ironforge, $N... no pressure on ya to become somethin' special.

3182.name: Proof of Deed
desc: Take Margol's Gigantic Horn to Curator Thorius in Ironforge.
objectives: Take Margol's Gigantic Horn to Curator Thorius in Ironforge.
details: You expect me to believe a story like that? The real horn would have had my broken axe head still lodged into its surface.

BListen, take that obvious fake to Curator Thorius in Ironforge. If he can validate your claim, you will receive a proof of deed. Bring that proof back to me and I'll give you the key to the Searing Gorge.
BGet going!
completion: What's this?
BOh my, I don't believe it! Do you realize what you've got here, $R? This is the horn of Margol the Rager! Margol, the bane of every archaeologist that ever set foot in the Searing Gorge.
BMay I keep it?

3374.name: The Essence of Eranikus
desc: Bring the Oathstone of Ysera's Dragonflight and the Chained Essence of Eranikus to Itharius in the Swamp of Sorrows. It is there that you will make your choice to aid Ysera's Dragonflight or not.
objectives: Bring the Oathstone of Ysera's Dragonflight and the Chained Essence of Eranikus to Itharius in the Swamp of Sorrows. It is there that you will make your choice to aid Ysera's Dragonflight or not.
details: You engage the Oathstone, and Itharius speaks directly to your mind through the stone.

B"By accepting the charge placed in this Oathstone, you agree to aid my cause and the cause of Ysera's Dragonflight in redeeming the corrupted soul of Eranikus. The first sacrifice, one of many you and I will no doubt make, will be to relinquish the gem to me that has chained what free-willed part of Eranikus' psyche remains."
B"Do this $N, and we will work together to redeem a soul worthy of redemption."
completion: You have made your choice, and so it begins. Your choices have been, to date, what I would consider to be the correct ones; your actions and deeds henceforth will determine whether this is to continue.

3446.name: Into the Depths
desc: Find the Altar of Hakkar in the Sunken Temple in Swamp of Sorrows.
objectives: Find the Altar of Hakkar in the Sunken Temple in Swamp of Sorrows.
details: Inside the temple, I found a circular room with six balconies, each one with a serpent statue on the edge. Curious, I pushed one of them to see what would happen, and it was a trap! I nearly fell to my death from the explosion. Laying there on the ledge, I looked down and noticed that there was another statue at the base of the room; an altar of sorts... Hakkar, I think it was called.
BI think that this altar is the secret -- you must bring this token to the altar in the Sunken Temple.
completion: You push the stone circle into the opening, and you hear it lock into place.
BNow that the stone is in place, you may continue... but what should you do next?
BPerhaps you should examine this altar further...
B

3518.name: Delivery to Magatha
desc: Bring the Tablet of Beth'Amara to Magatha in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Bring the Tablet of Beth'Amara to Magatha in Thunder Bluff.
details: The first tablet goes to a tauren female... one called Magatha. She is among the elders in Thunder Bluff, and is one of the proponents of the alliance between the tauren and the Forsaken. She, more than anyone among the elders, feels the tauren and their ways can help the Forsaken find a path back to being human.
BBring her the Tablet of Beth'Amara. The tablet may be the link she needs in finding a way to help the Forsaken... or so she claims.
completion: Ah, at long last, the Tablet of Beth'Amara. I was wondering if my partnership with Jediga had failed or if the poor orc had found her death in Azshara. I am glad she was successful.
BBeth'Amara was one of the Highborne's most influential alchemists. The wizard alone was said to have mastered transmuting metals among other things.

3542.name: Delivery to Andron Gant
desc: Bring the Tablet of Markri to Andron Gant in Undercity.
objectives: Bring the Tablet of Markri to Andron Gant in Undercity.
details: Andron Gant is my next contact. He usually holds himself up in the Undercity... right near the Apothecarium.

BHe was a little more loose-lipped when it came to speaking about what he wanted the Tablet for. Apparently some of the mages of Undercity are looking to study some of the arcane spells the highborne used. They think this tablet will help them. Markri was adept at summoning creatures; especially elementals.
BTake the Tablet of Markri and return to me for your part of the reward.
completion: Here, take some coin... get yerself... <hic>... some new armor or something....
BThis'll bring a shiny gold or two to the right... <hic> people.

3566.name: Rise, Obsidion!
desc: Slay Lathoric the Black and Obsidion, and return to Thorius in Ironforge with the Head of Lathoric the Black and the Heart of Obsidion.
objectives: Slay Lathoric the Black and Obsidion, and return to Thorius in Ironforge with the Head of Lathoric the Black and the Heart of Obsidion.
details: It... It... It was all a trap.
BForgive... me.
BKill the bastard... Kill him for us... for Thorius.
completion: <Thorius' face turns white.>
BThis... this cannot be. My own brother? He set this all up?
B<Thorius' face contorts in anger.>

BHe betrayed me, he betrayed Ironforge! It seems as if the influence of the Old Gods is still strong in these lands. I fear that if my brother - a once noble and honorable man - was so easily turned to the will of Ragnaros, no one is safe.

3638.name: The Pledge of Secrecy
desc: If you agree to become a Goblin Engineer, then right-click on the Pledge of Secrecy and speak once more with Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.
objectives: If you agree to become a Goblin Engineer, then right-click on the Pledge of Secrecy and speak once more with Nixx Sprocketspring in Gadgetzan.
details: Goblin engineering is about practical uses for high profit and higher explosive power! Our schemata allow us to make powerful bombs and mighty weaponry; the manual you read covered this.
BThe manual also covered our ages old oath of secrecy on our schemata. Once you become a goblin engineer, that's that. There is no access to gnome engineering at all.
BIf you still want to become a goblin engineer, sign this document pledging life-long secrecy and speak with me again. Think about it carefully, $N.
completion: Welcome aboard, Goblin Engineer $N! You soon will have access to the most powerful engineering schemata anywhere on Azeroth.

BNow that you have committed yourself to the pursuit of this knowledge, it is time to examine your goblin-oriented engineering work. From there, we'll help you build a plan to maximize your goblin engineering talents!

3782.name: Morrowgrain Research
desc: Take the Seed Voucher to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
objectives: Take the Seed Voucher to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.
details: With what we call an Evergreen Pouch, we have cultivated Tharlendris seeds in the soil from Un'Goro Crater. These seeds have blossomed into an array of random, potent herbs. One result is morrowgrain, a mysterious herb we know little about; I very much hope to unravel this mystery for the Circle.
BTake this voucher over to my daughter Bashana, and she will give you some seeds so you may assist us. If you run out, you will need to purchase more from her.
completion: Yes, this voucher is good for twenty packets of seeds. If you run out, we have more that can be provided. Unfortunately though, Tharlendris seeds are quite costly to produce in significant numbers. This is why the Cenarion Circle asks that those who are assisting us help out by offsetting some of the cost.
BThose who return with morrowgrain find that the reward the Arch Druid offers far makes up for the cost.

3902.name: Scavenging Deathknell
desc: Search Deathknell and the vicinity for 6 pieces of Scavenged Goods, and return them to Deathguard Saltain.
objectives: Search Deathknell and the vicinity for 6 pieces of Scavenged Goods, and return them to Deathguard Saltain.
details: You there! If you're looking for something to make yourself useful, then listen up!

BWe need fresh out-of-the-ground recruits to head into Deathknell and search for any sort of useful equipment. Most likely, they'll be in stacks of boxes. We expect more recruits to be rising soon, and unless we want them to stumble about naked we had better get to scavenging!
BWell get to work, you miserable bag of bones! I'm not going to reward those without some hustle.
completion: Great work $N, I knew you weren't useless. Here - have one of the better items I've found out of the lots that have been collected so far.

4022.name: A Taste of Flame
desc: Show Cyrus Therepentous the Black Dragonflight Molt you received from Kalaran Windblade.
objectives: Show Cyrus Therepentous the Black Dragonflight Molt you received from Kalaran Windblade.$B
details: The flight is aware of your work in the Searing Gorge.
BShow it to me, $r. The molt, imbecile.
completion: <Cyrus examines the molt.>
BYou have proven that you are not entirely useless, mortal.

4142.name: A Visit to Gregan
desc: Take a Bloodpetal to Gregan Brewspewer in Feralas.
objectives: Take a Bloodpetal to Gregan Brewspewer in Feralas.
details: I'm not quite sure what to make of this, $N. The plants... they seem to have some minimal intelligence.
BI'm no expert, though. But, I do know someone that is!
BHead to northern Feralas, and look for a buddy of mine named Gregan Brewspewer. He's an expert on this sort of thing.
BI'm sure Gregan can help us out here. You'll find him out in the wilderness; he's not the type to live in a big city.
completion: Bloodpetal, eh? Hmmm... Well, you better explain the plan, and then I'll tell you whether or not I can help you.

4262.name: Overmaster Pyron
desc: Slay Overmaster Pyron and return to Jalinda Sprig.
You recall Jalinda talking about Pyron guarding the quarry. Perhaps you should search there?
objectives: Slay Overmaster Pyron and return to Jalinda Sprig.
BYou recall Jalinda talking about Pyron guarding the quarry. Perhaps you should search there?
details: The last five of my mages that went snooping around in Blackrock Mountain came back extra crispy with a permanent orange gnomefro - or worse.
B<Jalinda picks up some ashes from the ground and releases them into the air.>
BOne nasty bugger in particular, Overmaster Pyron, seems to be causing quite a bit of trouble. We need that elemental terminated so that our expedition crew can make its way into Blackrock Depths!
BHe guards the entrance at the Blackrock Quarry.
completion: Incendius? Oh dear...

4286.name: The Good Stuff
desc: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 20 Dark Iron Fanny Packs. Return to Oralius when you have completed this task. You assume that the Dark Iron dwarves inside Blackrock Depths carry these 'fanny pack' contraptions.
objectives: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 20 Dark Iron Fanny Packs. Return to Oralius when you have completed this task. You assume that the Dark Iron dwarves inside Blackrock Depths carry these 'fanny pack' contraptions.$B
details: Captain Winky tells me that the Dark Irons in the Depths got all the good stuff. Ain't that right, Winky?
B<Oralius does his best impersonation of a pirate.>
BARRR MATEY! IT BE RIGHT!
BSee what I'm saying? You need to get in there and bring me back some samples of the good stuff.
BGet in there and shake your moneymaker!$B
completion: <Oralius starts rummaging through the mountainous pile of fanny packs.>
BOH WONDERFUL!
B<Oralius sticks his large nose into the pile and takes a whiff.>
BDELICIOUS! Look at all these goodies!
BTake one for yourself, $N. There's plenty to go around.

4502.name: Volcanic Activity
desc: Collect 9 samples of Un'Goro Ash from the fire elementals around the volcano in Un'Goro Crater, and return them to Liv Rizzlefix in Ratchet.
objectives: Collect 9 samples of Un'Goro Ash from the fire elementals around the volcano in Un'Goro Crater, and return them to Liv Rizzlefix in Ratchet.
details: Being an apprentice to Marvon Rivetseeker, I've learned so much. But he's been gone for such a long time now, so I think I'm going to work on some experiments of my own.

BI've been reading about Un'Goro Crater most recently, and about the strange volcanic activity going on in the middle of the crater. I think a lot could be learned if I could just get some of the ash from the elementals there.
BDo you think you'd mind collecting some for me, if you are going that way?
completion: These samples will be perfect for my studies! Thank you, $N! I promise, you'll be the first one I will tell about my findings.

4742.name: Seal of Ascension
desc: Find the three gemstones of command: The Gemstone of Smolderthorn, Gemstone of Spirestone, and Gemstone of Bloodaxe. Return them, along with the Unadorned Seal of Ascension, to Vaelan.
The Generals, as told to you by Vaelan, are: War Master Voone of the Smolderthorn; Highlord Omokk of the Spirestone; and Overlord Wyrmthalak of the Bloodaxe.
objectives: Find the three gemstones of command: The Gemstone of Smolderthorn, Gemstone of Spirestone, and Gemstone of Bloodaxe. Return them, along with the Unadorned Seal of Ascension, to Vaelan.
BThe Generals, as told to you by Vaelan, are: War Master Voone of the Smolderthorn; Highlord Omokk of the Spirestone; and Overlord Wyrmthalak of the Bloodaxe.
details: As you can see, the unadorned seal has three empty sockets. Each of those sockets must be filled with a gemstone representing the leadership's command. Finally, Overlord Wyrmthalak, master of the lower citadel, must forge the seal in the flames of the Black Dragonflight.
BUnderstand this, mortal: the chance that one of the three generals of the lower citadel would carry a gemstone at any given time is rare. You must be vigilant in your quest. Remain determined!
completion: <Vaelan's image blurs for a moment.>
B<The pieces that you had collected have disappeared.>
BThe Unforged Seal of Ascension is now ready. It is time for the final step.

4766.name: Mayara Brightwing
desc: Speak with Mayara Brightwing in the Burning Steppes.
objectives: Speak with Mayara Brightwing in the Burning Steppes.
details: An agent of mine, Mayara Brightwing, was sent to the Burning Steppes to scout the ruined city of Thaurissan. That destroyed city of the Dark Iron dwarves may hide objects of great value... objects that would fit nicely into our family museum.
BMayara says she found something and will need aid in retrieving it, but it is not in Thaurissan. Instead, a foray into Blackrock Spire will be required.
BI do not know the details, but if interested then speak with Mayara in the Burning Steppes.
completion: You came from Stormwind? Wonderful -- I know of an object of art that Remington would kill to have in his museum, but extracting it won't be easy.
BThat's where you come in.

4862.name: En-Ay-Es-Tee-Why
desc: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 15 Spire Spider Eggs for Kibler.
By the sound of it, these eggs could be found near spiders.
objectives: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 15 Spire Spider Eggs for Kibler.
BBy the sound of it, these eggs could be found near spiders.$B
details: Believe it or not, there are people out there willing to pay for the most vile of domesticated beast!
BI'd sent Bijou into the Spire to try and collect some of those spire spider eggs but I haven't heard from her in weeks. Maybe you can help me out?
BI'll tell you what, $N. Go to Blackrock Spire and collect some spire spider eggs for me. Bring them back here and not only will I give you a little cash, but I'll even domesticate one for you!
