completion: What a load! I mean, look at all those eggs! These should bring in a right few gold.
BAs promised, here's your own little critter. Don't get bitten!

4982.name: Bijou's Belongings
desc: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. You recall her mentioning that she stashed them on the bottom floor of the city.
objectives: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. You recall her mentioning that she stashed them on the bottom floor of the city.$B
details: At night when this place is lightly guarded, I sneak around the city, taking notes and writing down anything I see that could be of some strategic value to the K.E.F.

BLast night, however, things went dreadfully wrong. I stumbled across a tripwire and set off an alarm. I stashed my recon gear and ran for cover! Unfortunately, I can't get back to that gear. They've doubled and tripled up the patrols! All that information is lost.
BGet my belongings back and I'll return to the K.E.F. peacefully.
completion: You've done it! Once Lexlort has these plans, he'll forget all about the nasty things he wanted to do to me.
B$N, you're my hero!

5054.name: Ursius of the Shardtooth
desc: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Ursius.
objectives: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Ursius.
details: In the snowy mountains of Winterspring, to the northwest, a skilled hunter stalks his prey... I speak of Ursius of the shardtooth bears, an agile and clever beast.
BI send you now against him. He roams the sloping hills to the northwest of Everlook. Find and hunt him, before he discovers your intent.
BAll that have gone up against Ursius have quickly found themselves to be the prey, and he, the hunter. Stay on your guard.
completion: This was no easy task, yet you have excelled. But do not be too quick to think you have impressed me, $N.

5102.name: General Drakkisath's Demise
desc: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy General Drakkisath. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.
objectives: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy General Drakkisath. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.$B
details: We battle against these beasts on two fronts: From our capital of Stormwind we fight them from the inside out and here, in the Burning Steppes, we take the battle to their doorstep. We must be vigilant, $N. None should be spared our wrath as none of our own were spared when they struck at our homes and families.
BFind this General Drakkisath and destroy him!
BThe task certainly will not be a simple one, but the rewards shall be extravagant.
completion: Surely, we will strike against their dragon lords next. Well done, brave soldier of the Alliance! Well done, indeed.

5126.name: Lorax's Tale
desc: Speak with Lorax. Listen to what he has to say.
objectives: Speak with Lorax. Listen to what he has to say.$B
details: The Satyr paces about and talks to himself. Do you wish to question him?
completion: NULL

5222.name: Target: Writhing Haunt
desc: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
objectives: Go to the Writhing Haunt in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron. You must have the Empty Writhing Haunt Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.
details: Two cauldrons have been successfully opened; while you will be able to access them indefinitely, we still want to open up the other two that remain. This will provide all of us with more options to introduce the counter agent!

BThis time, you'll be hitting the Writhing Haunt's cauldron. It is almost due east of Andorhal, relatively close to the ruined city walls; again, eliminate the cauldron lord present there for its key. Use this bottle to obtain the sample from the cauldron.
BGood hunting, $N!
completion: The cauldron lord's key unlocks the access panel to this cauldron and then disappears, much like the other keys have for the previous two cauldrons you've dealt of. A putrid smelling substance churns violently beneath the platform of the cauldron.
BThere is a small spigot that the bottle fits well enough under, allowing you to draw a sample for High Priestess MacDonnell back at Chillwind Point.

5246.name: Fragments of the Past
desc: Find the Sacred Highborne Writings in the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara, and bring them to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Find the Sacred Highborne Writings in the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara, and bring them to Aurora Skycaller near the Northpass Tower in Eastern Plaguelands.
details: I did not realize... Forgive my callous words, $c.
BThe mistakes of my ancestors are not what I wish to dwell on, but if your request is truly genuine, then I will help you.
B<Aurora examines the fragments.>

BI believe this is the Crystal of Zin-Malor, an artifact that can contain and control strong arcane forces. It could have been used for good, but the evil intentions of those that stole it caused it to shatter.
BGo to the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara - I can only hope the book is still there.
completion: The pages have gone untouched for many many years...

5342.name: The Last Barov
desc: Travel to Chillwind Camp - Alliance territory - and assassinate Weldon Barov. Take his head and return to Alexi Barov.
Be warned, Weldon will probably be well protected by Alliance scum.
objectives: Travel to Chillwind Camp - Alliance territory - and assassinate Weldon Barov. Take his head and return to Alexi Barov.
BBe warned, Weldon will probably be well protected by Alliance scum.
details: Naturally, with my brother still alive, there may be some contention as to the primary beneficiary of the family's fortune. This cannot be.
BA low down guttersnipe like you isn't above a little cold-blooded murder, I hope.
BIt's a simple task and one that I expect you will complete; that is, if you wish to claim your reward.
BWeldon sits under Alliance protection at Chillwind Camp, to the east. Slay him, return his head.
B<Alexi yawns.>
BHurry along now.
completion: Wonderful! Now only I hold the power and fortune of house Barov!
B<Alexi throws a large bag at you.>
BAnd keep the change, you filthy animal.

5462.name: The Dying, Ras Frostwhisper
desc: Travel to Light's Hope in Eastern Plaguelands and seek out Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. Show him the Keepsake of Remembrance and tell him all that you have discovered.
objectives: Travel to Light's Hope in Eastern Plaguelands and seek out Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. Show him the Keepsake of Remembrance and tell him all that you have discovered.
details: Upon tainted soil, the keepsake must be attuned.
BIt is rumored that Stratholme is where Frostwhisper succumbed to the Lich King. Upon those bloodied grounds he gave his life - freely and with motive - to become one of the undying.
BIt is those grounds that must be found.

BThere is one, an undead dissenter of the Scourge, freed by the Banshee Queen but loyal to the cause of the Argent Dawn. Find him: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. He may know more. Seek out Light's Hope, $N.
completion: <Leonid looks over the keepsake.>
BYour quandary stirs up memories that I had hoped would never resurface.

5534.name: Kim'jael's "Missing" Equipment
desc: Find Some Rune that the naga have in their possession in the Ruins of Eldarath and return it to Kim'jael in Azshara.
objectives: Find Some Rune that the naga have in their possession in the Ruins of Eldarath and return it to Kim'jael in Azshara.
details: What?! What?!

BThat wasn't good enough for you? You know how expensive those explosives are? They sell for... oh, nevermind. Fine, you want to make some real money? Cause that's how business is done: you prove you're a valuable employee and then you're rewarded adequately after you stick it out some.
BIf you're a "valuable" employee, then hit the Ruins of Eldarath and find me some rune that them Blood elves were lookin' for. The naga apparently have it in their possession.
completion: Haha! Wonderful!
BI'll be sure to find out what this is for and why Magus Rimtori--she's the cow that hired me--wanted it. Hah! I got you now, stinkin' Blood elves! Kim'jael! Ha! I'll teach them who the rats are!
BYa did good, $N. Thanks a bundle. Here, take this coin and be off with ya--I've got some things to figure out.

5582.name: Healthy Dragon Scale
desc: Bring the Healthy Dragon Scale to Betina Bigglezink at the Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.

5630.name: Returning Home
desc: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
objectives: Speak to Priestess Alathea in Darnassus.
details: Hello there, $gladdy:lassy;. Good to see you travelin' far and wide to distant lands. No offense meant, but a lot o' your kind don't take well to these cold climates usually. Glad to see you're made of tougher stuff.

BNot too long ago one of your priestesses was in here lookin' for you--said somethin' about you finding a Priestess Alathea in the Temple of the Moon back in Darnassus. Said it was important and you should head back there soon.
completion: Wonderful, you've returned home, $N. It always pleases Tyrande and myself when those we've trained go out into the world and return to us safely. How have things been with you? Does Elune still bless your travels? Perhaps after we speak more about the business at hand, you could tell me more of your travels.

5654.name: Hex of Weakness
desc: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Speak to Ur'kyo in Orgrimmar.
details: It be time for you to meet with Ur'kyo, $N. He be in the Valley of Spirits in the orc city. Go there and speak to him. It is time you learn more of the old ways of our kind. It time you be brought into the circle and made a true priest of our tribe.
completion: You would do well to pay heed to this lesson, young one. The Hex of Weakness will be a great boon to you in battle. Later I will have tests for you to further yourself and prove your worth to the tribe.

5726.name: Hidden Enemies
desc: Bring a Lieutenant's Insignia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring a Lieutenant's Insignia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.
details: One thing I will not tolerate are traitors in our midst, $N. But I would be a fool to play my hand so early--it would not sufficiently cut the corruption out of our lands and only cause the infection to grow worse.
BBut you, a young adventurer, could go places my agents could not... could learn the truth... could find the true head of the beast.
BIf you are brave enough, then enter Skull Rock to the east of Orgrimmar, find a lieutenant's insignia off one of the Burning Blade there, and return to me.
completion: Good, $N! The spirits be praised, perhaps you are the one who will finally put my greatest fears to rest! Who would suspect someone so young and so brave would rise up and champion our cause? You remind me of myself when I was younger. I will ensure that you are justly rewarded for your efforts if we both survive the coming storm.
BBut there is time for more praise later. You've not accomplished anything in comparison to what you will face... but this is a good start.

5846.name: Of Love and Family
desc: Travel to island of Caer Darrow, in the south-central region of the Plaguelands, and look for any clues as to the whereabouts of the painting.
objectives: Travel to island of Caer Darrow, in the south-central region of the Plaguelands, and look for any clues as to the whereabouts of the painting.
details: When Taelan was a child, we would oft visit Caer Darrow on family excursions. On our last visit, an artist by the name of Renfray painted a portrait of us poised along the beachside. It is my fondest memory of both Taelan and Karandra. For it was at that moment, with my wife and son in my arms, that I felt a bond of love and family that I would never know again.
BIf this painting still exists, you must find it.
BTravel to the ruined island of Caer Darrow and see if the painting or the artist remain.
completion: How could I forget? Many of the spirits on this island are cursed to relive their last happy memory before they met their tragic end.
BI too am cursed, but not as they - I am one of the few that remembers all...
BPerhaps this thing that you ask me is why I haunt these ruins. Perhaps this thing I tell you shall set me free.

5942.name: Hidden Treasures
desc: Bring Joseph's Key to Joseph's Chest.
objectives: Bring Joseph's Key to Joseph's Chest.
details: Daddy told me to give you this key. He said it opens a chest out back behind the house.
BHe also wanted me to thank you. Did you do a favor for him? Did you tell him you found my doll?
BWell here's the key. And thank you $N. Thank you! You're a very nice $gman:lady;!
completion: The key fits the lock, and the chest opens...

6062.name: Taming the Beast
desc: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Dire Mottled Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Thotar in Razor Hill.
objectives: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Dire Mottled Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Thotar in Razor Hill.
details: It is an admirable skill to command one's authority over nature. As a hunter, you must strive to learn to use the force and power inherent to any creature of your choosing.
BGaining control of an animal is not an easy feat; it is a task that you must undertake with much determination.

BFor your first assignment, take this taming rod and use it to tame a dire mottled boar. You can find them quite close to Razor Hill. Practice your skills in battle with the boar at your side, then return to me.
completion: You have done well, $N. I believe you are ready for your next task.

6086.name: Training the Beast
desc: Speak with Belia Thundergranite in Ironforge.
objectives: Speak with Belia Thundergranite in Ironforge.
details: $N, ya now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills ta train it.

BTravel to Ironforge and find the Hall of Arms. There you must speak to one of our most revered animal trainers, Belia Thundergranite. She'll give ya the power to train your new pet, so get goin', $Glad:lass;!
BBelia is a friendly sort; you should have no problems gaining her approval. Good luck, $N.$B
completion: A new recruit, eh? You're on your way to becoming a great $C, I see.

BYes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.
BRemember that the key to getting the most from your new pet is to respect it and treat it well. In turn, your pet will be your most loyal friend.

6134.name: Ghost-o-plasm Round Up
desc: Bring 8 Ghost-o-plasms and the Crate of Ghost Magnets to Hornizz Brimbuzzle in Desolace.
objectives: Bring 8 Ghost-o-plasms and the Crate of Ghost Magnets to Hornizz Brimbuzzle in Desolace.
details: There's a valley to the southeast, the Valley of Bones, haunted by Magram ghosts. Sounds scary, doesn't it? Well think how scary it is to the Magram! If we captured ghost energy from that place, I bet it'd be worth plenty to those centaurs.

BHere, take this crate of ghost magnets. If you place one between the two big skeletons in the valley, the Dead Goliaths, then ghosts will wander to it. Distance yourself, take out the ghosts and get their ghost-o-plasm--that's what we'll sell to the Magram.
completion: There it is! Looks like you got some of it on you too. Kinda slimey, eh?
BWell, thanks a lot for all the trouble, $N. This stuff will be worth a fortune... if I can convince the centaurs what it is!

6182.name: The First and the Last
desc: Speak with Mathias Shaw in Old Town Stormwind. He resides in the Barracks.
objectives: Speak with Mathias Shaw in Old Town Stormwind. He resides in the Barracks.
details: Nathanos Marris was the first and last of the human ranger lords. A disciple of Sylvanas Windrunner, now the Banshee Queen of the Forsaken.

BWe had thought that Nathanos had been killed in action in the defense of Lordaeron five years ago. Although his corpse was never recovered, it was assumed that he did not make it out of the Eastern Plaguelands.
BMathias Shaw has been investigating the disappearance and may have some new information. Report to him at once. He resides in Old Town, at the Barracks.
completion: After some reports of unusual Forsaken activity in the Eastern Plaguelands, SI:7 agents were dispatched to investigate. The results of that investigation are unsettling.

6542.name: Report to Kadrak
desc: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.
objectives: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.
details: Have you ever been to Ashenvale, to the north? The horde has recently set up an outpost on the Zoram Strand there, and we can always use some new recruits to help defend our new fronts.
BIf you think you are up to it, see Kadrak in the northern Barrens, at the watch tower. He is heading up the Ashenvale campaign and can give you further orders.$B
completion: Ashenvale is a divided land, but our most recent efforts have been very successful. We not only have an outpost at the Zoram Strand, but another just north of here called Splintertree.

6566.name: What the Wind Carries
desc: Listen to Thrall.
objectives: Listen to Thrall.
details: It is good to see you again, $N. The wind carries with it news from the Eastern Kingdom.
BSit, listen. $B
completion: Are you prepared to take on this task?

6662.name: Me Brother, Nipsy
desc: Take the Carton of Mystery Meat to Nipsy at the Stormwind Deeprun Tram Depot.
objectives: Take the Carton of Mystery Meat to Nipsy at the Stormwind Deeprun Tram Depot.
details: Me brother, Nipsy, runs a rat kabob operation on the other side of Deeprun. Ye needs to take this here crate o' rats to him before they go bad. Get a move on!
BYe have ridden a tram before, aye? It's easy. Just step aboard when she arrives and enjoy the ride. An' keep yer arms and legs inside durin' the ride, lest ye be peglegged fer life.
completion: Poor Monty. Ever since the Gnomeregan incident, he hasn't been the same. That boy has never seen an ocean in his life, let alone being some kind of pirate.
B<Nipsy sighs.>
BAt least he keeps the flow of twitching critters coming.

7022.name: Greatfather Winter is Here!
desc: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Ironforge.
objectives: Speak with Greatfather Winter; he is located near the Smokywood Pastures vendor area in Ironforge.
details: Have a wondrous Winter Veil, friend! Be sure to say hello to Greatfather Winter! If you've been nice this year, you'll receive wondrous treats on the day of the Feast of Winter Veil. Be sure to tell him what you hope to get this year!

BAlso, be sure to stock up on treats to give those who've been nice this year. We have a great selection to choose from. Fresh from our farm to your plate - it's Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness!
completion: Ho ho hello. I am Greatfather Winter, and I - courtesy of the fine folks of Smokywood Pastures... "Fresh from our farm to your plate, it's Smokywood Pastures wholesome goodness" - would like to wish you a fantastic Feast of Winter Veil.
BIf you've been good this year, maybe you will receive treats from Smokywood Pastures as your treat for the Feast of Winter Veil. Huzzah.

7046.name: The Scepter of Celebras
desc: Assist Celebras the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of Celebras.
Speak with him when the ritual is complete.
objectives: Assist Celebras the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of Celebras.
BSpeak with him when the ritual is complete.
details: My scepter was once a source of hope for me. Its power allowed me the freedom to travel quickly through these caverns. I had hoped to bring peace to the spirit of my uncle... It is a task that I now pass to you.

BFor the two parts to once again become one, I will need your assistance in performing the ritual. Please follow me, and listen to my instructions while I channel the energy required to reunite the rod with the diamond.
BTogether, we shall create the Scepter of Celebras once again!
completion: Please take this, and know that the power allotted to you now must be used for good. Continue your journey through the caverns, and with hope, you will find the remains of my uncle. Much danger awaits you, $N.
BSpeak with me again should the need arise.

7070.name: Shadowshard Fragments
desc: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Archmage Tervosh in Theramore on the coast of Dustwallow Marsh.
objectives: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Archmage Tervosh in Theramore on the coast of Dustwallow Marsh.
details: I've recently begun testing various crystals and their arcane properties. Lady Proudmoore has given me leave to ask travelers heading into Desolace to seek out a place called Maraudon. Within the ruined temple are great elementals composed of purplish stones I've named shadowshards.
BIf you decide to head that direction and find some of the crystals, I would be very thankful. I could even fashion you a trinket from them if you so desired.
completion: These are perfect, $N. I actually had other adventurers return from there also and from them I was able to fashion these... please, feel free to take one for your hard work. And thank you again for more samples to study.

7142.name: The Battle for Alterac
desc: Enter Alterac Valley and defeat the dwarven general, Vanndar Stormpike. Then, return to Voggah Deathgrip in the Alterac Mountains.
objectives: Enter Alterac Valley and defeat the dwarven general, Vanndar Stormpike. Then, return to Voggah Deathgrip in the Alterac Mountains.
details: The Stormpike dwarves and their allies have invaded Alterac Valley, and we must drive them out! To win the battle for Alterac, we must defeat their general, Vanndar Stormpike!
BYou will find Vanndar in Dun Baldar, in the north of Alterac Valley.
BDestroy him, $N, and then return to me.
completion: Well done, $N! Stormpikes have no hope in this foolish invasion.
BHah! So far, all they've done is get their general killed!

7166.name: Legendary Heroes
details: Your radiate command and power, shaman. Exalted in the eyes of Frostwolf - the enemy cowers at the mention of your name.
BRise, Hero of Frostwolf. Rise and be honored!
BPresent your insignia.
completion: Soon, all on the field of battle will be under your watchful eye. Command of the Valley and its troops will be yours!

7382.name: Korrak the Everliving
desc: Should Korrak the Bloodrager make a return to the Field of Strife, seek him out and destroy him.
Return the Skull of Korrak to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

7502.name: Harnessing Shadows
desc: Return the book to its rightful owners.
objectives: Return the book to its rightful owners.
details: The tome carries the mark of the Athenaeum.
completion: Excellent work, $R. Should you find any more tomes, do not hesitate to return them to us.
BAs time passes, we tend to change around and even add new rewards for the return of missing tomes.

7622.name: The Balance of Light and Shadow
desc: Save 50 Peasants before 15 are slain. Speak with Eris Havenfire should you accomplish this task.
You may view the Death Post to view how many Peasants have been slain.
objectives: Save 50 Peasants before 15 are slain. Speak with Eris Havenfire should you accomplish this task.
BYou may view the Death Post to view how many Peasants have been slain.
details: You must do what I could not: Save the peasants that were cut down while fleeing from Stratholme.
BThey will walk towards the light, you must ensure their survival. Should too many fall, our cursed existence shall continue - you will have failed.
BEvery ability, prayer, and spell that you have learned will be tested. May the Light protect you, $N.
completion: Your tenacity and courage are astounding, $gpriest:priestess;. You have earned the right to hold the Splinter of Nordrassil. Only one task remains: The Eye of Shadow must be recovered. Scour the world.

7646.name: The Divination Scryer
desc: Bring an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.
objectives: Bring an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.
details: We now must assemble a Divination Scryer - this will begin the trial that will allow you to redeem the fallen charger. Your scryer, actually, is almost done. The exorcism censer used in Terrordale is the catalyst for it, and I will fashion a suitable housing for the device.

BThe last components needed, though, are two diamonds. They must be as juxtaposed in brilliance as they are in purpose - an Azerothian and a Pristine Black. These two will be the beacon by which the scryer will pierce the shadows!
completion: These are fine specimens, $N - the final pieces are now in place. At long last, your time has come!

BIn the depths of the Great Ossuary of Scholomance are the skeletal remains of many beings. Amongst them is a once-noble charger. The hollowed soul of this charger now serves as the steed for Death Knight Darkreaver. It is he whom you will face, and it is this steed that you will pass judgment upon. Only you, $N, can redeem its soul and save it from the torment of its servitude.

7814.name: A Donation of Silk
completion: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, $N!

7862.name: Job Opening: Guard Captain of Revantusk Village
desc: You have been tasked with the decimation of 20 Vilebranch Berserkers, 20 Vilebranch Shadow Hunters, 20 Vilebranch Blood Drinkers, and 20 Vilebranch Soul Eaters.
Should you complete this task, return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.
objectives: You have been tasked with the decimation of 20 Vilebranch Berserkers, 20 Vilebranch Shadow Hunters, 20 Vilebranch Blood Drinkers, and 20 Vilebranch Soul Eaters.
BShould you complete this task, return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.
details: With the loss of Guard Captain Malkhor, the position of Guard Captain of Revantusk is once again open. If you are interested in becoming Captain of the Guard for Revantusk, complete the following tasks and submit your application to Primal Torntusk:
BExterminate Vilebranch Berserkers.
BExterminate Vilebranch Shadow Hunters.
BExterminate Vilebranch Blood Drinkers.
BExterminate Vilebranch Soul Eaters.
completion: You are indeed a worthy candidate for the new position, $N. Accept this trinket as a token of our appreciation for your hard work. I will be reviewing all applications next year.

7886.name: Talismans of Merit
desc: You obtained a Silverwing Talisman of Merit for your last task, talk to me again, and you gain your reward.

8054.name: Paragons of Power: The Freethinker's Belt
desc: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Shawl. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
Jin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
objectives: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Shawl. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
BJin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
details: Your beliefs are alien to us, heathen. Ancient Zandalar were once branded as heretics. This was when the Gurubashi Empire was strong. Heathens dared to challenge the priest of Hakkar. Heathens then were hunted and killed as vermin. Those heathens never wavered in their fight against the Blood God. We honor the price they paid. They are the freethinkers.
BDestroy the minions of Hakkar in Zul'Gurub. Bring me the Paragons of Power I seek. Success will be greatly rewarded.
BGo.
completion: Your honor is assured in the tribe. You claim many deaths in Zul'Gurub. Enemies fall before your convictions. Enemies fall before your power.
BThis is the freethinker's belt. It is a symbol of honor. It is powerful mojo. It is now yours.

8078.name: Paragons of Power: The Vindicator's Belt
desc: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Girdle. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
Jin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
objectives: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Girdle. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
BJin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
details: The ultimate vengeance waits within Zul'Gurub. Hakkar must not rise again. Hakkar destroyed the Gurubashi Empire from within. No sacrifice was enough. The trolls are a shadow of former glories. I know this is because of Hakkar.

BBecome the vindicator you were meant to be. Wreak havoc on the minions of evil. Zul'Gurub must taste Zandalar vengeance. Bring me proof in the Paragons of Power. You will receive the vindicator's belt. You will receive real power.
BGo.
completion: The way of the vindicator is now known to you. You have brought honor to the tribe. You have brought honor to yourself. You have brought pain to our enemies.
BThe vindicator's belt is yours. You are surely becoming one with the way of the vindicator.

8102.name: The Pebble of Kajaro
completion: Be unstoppable, like the molten fronts of Kajaro.

8150.name: Honoring a Hero
desc: Travel to Grom's Monument in the Demon Fall Canyon of Ashenvale and use Grom's Tribute at the base of the monument. Return to Javnir Nashak outside Orgrimmar before the Harvest Festival is over.
objectives: Travel to Grom's Monument in the Demon Fall Canyon of Ashenvale and use Grom's Tribute at the base of the monument. Return to Javnir Nashak outside Orgrimmar before the Harvest Festival is over.
details: During the Harvest Festival of Azeroth, we give thanks to heroes for the sacrifices - in some cases ultimate sacrifices - they have given on our behalf. The Horde acknowledges many heroes, but none exemplify strength and sacrifice more than Grom Hellscream.

BHelp us honor Grom by taking this offering to his monument in the Demon Fall Canyon of Ashenvale. Place it at the base, and then return to me. I'll only be here through the end of the festival, so waste no time in giving Grom his tribute.
completion: Grom's full name - Grommash - means "The Giant's Heart"; it took that and more to stand alone against Mannoroth. I think the Warchief said it best when the curse of the orcs began and ended with Grom. Fitting that Grom's sacrifice - and perhaps redemption - would be the wellspring from which the Horde flows today.
BThank you, $N. You've paid tribute to a great hero today, honoring his spirit and the spirit of the Harvest Festival.

8294.name: Quell the Silverwing Usurpers
desc: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Alliance, gain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and bring it to Captain Shatterskull at the Mor'shan Base Camp.
objectives: Enter Warsong Gulch and defeat the Alliance, gain a Warsong Gulch Mark of Honor, and bring it to Captain Shatterskull at the Mor'shan Base Camp.
details: The wilds of the Ashenvale forest will succumb to the might of the Horde, $r. Nothing the Silverwing say or do can stop our sovereign imperative. Kalimdor belongs to the Horde. How dare they attempt to prevent us from harvesting what is rightfully ours!

BLet the pride swell in your chest as you cut down their weak attempts at slowing our progress. Destroy the Silverwing Sentinels, and earn a Warsong mark of honor. Return to me with such a mark, $N, and you will be rewarded.
completion: <Captain Shatterskull roars in triumph.>
BHow much more can they withstand? How many more Alliance filth must perish at the hands of the Horde for them to retreat? Only time will tell, $R.

8318.name: Secret Communication
desc: Bring 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
objectives: Bring 10 Encrypted Twilight Texts to Bor Wildmane in Cenarion Hold.
details: Some of the Twilight's Hammer cultists carry around little papers with gibberish written on them. I want you to bring me a stack of them, $c.

BI can't figure out what the gibberish means, but that's not the point! These papers are how their different groups communicate secretly. The more texts we take out of circulation, the less they can communicate!
completion: Excellent! I'll stash these away, maybe they'll be useful later.

8366.name: Southsea Shakedown
desc: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle of Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris wants you to kill 10 Southsea Pirates, 10 Southsea Freebooters, 10 Southsea Dock Workers and 10 Southsea Swashbucklers.
objectives: Security Chief Bilgewhizzle of Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris wants you to kill 10 Southsea Pirates, 10 Southsea Freebooters, 10 Southsea Dock Workers and 10 Southsea Swashbucklers.
details: Argh! They want the impossible from me!
BThe Steamwheedle Cartel wants me to teach the Southsea pirates a lesson. The problem is that I can't be in two places at once; I need to stay here to keep the peace.
BOf late, the pirates have been disregarding the protection money that the cartel regularly forks over. So I'd like to temporarily deputize you to go down there and show them what for.
BYou'll find them at Lost Rigger Cove, which is not too far to the south. Thanks $N, I'll owe you one!
completion: $N! You are the man!!!

BI'm sure that the Cartel will ease up on me now that you've dealt with those Southsea scum. Let's see, what can I give you as a reward? How about a little coin and you choose from one of these for your trouble?

8390.name: Conquering Arathi Basin
desc: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.

8414.name: Dispelling Evil
desc: Collect 20 Minion's Scourgestones and bring them to High Priest Thel'danis in the Western Plaguelands.
objectives: Collect 20 Minion's Scourgestones and bring them to High Priest Thel'danis in the Western Plaguelands.
details: Greetings, $c. Crusaders like you are a welcome sight in these desolate reaches.

BYour holy strength is needed to help fight the endless undead here. We need you to collect a large number of scourgestones and bring them to High Priest Thel'danis. The high priest can be found guarding Uther's Tomb in Sorrow Hill, not far from here.
BOnly one with an Argent Dawn Commission can hope to find scourgestones, so speak to Officer Pureheart if you haven't already.
completion: There is risk in dispelling the evil from a scourgestone, for it attracts the attention of undead for countless miles. But you are strong in the Light, $N, and I do not fear for you...

8438.name: Conquering Arathi Basin
desc: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
objectives: Bring 3 Arathi Basin Mark of Honor to a Horde Warbringer outside the battlegrounds.
details: Our conflict with the Alliance has escalated to a true war. No longer are false pretenses to enter into battle used or expected by either side at this point.

BThe battle for the Arathi Basin is one of resources, plain and simple. Either the Alliance gets the resources and uses them against us or we get them and use them to keep our war efforts going. Help the Defilers maintain the flow of resources we need, $N!
completion: Securing our resources in Arathi is an important task! You've done well, $N.

8462.name: Speak to Nafien
desc: Travel north along the main road in Felwood and speak with the furbolg named Nafien. He stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
objectives: Travel north along the main road in Felwood and speak with the furbolg named Nafien. He stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
details: Perhaps you are capable of handling a larger threat that we Timbermaw face. You certainly have shown yourself capable here...

BAnother of my kind stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold, along this road far to the north. His name is Nafien; while he may appear to be a feral and unsavory beast, fear him not. He only seeks aid against the malign forces that threaten our home.
completion: Ah... I have heard the word on the wind about those not of our tribe who seek to ally themselves with the Timbermaw furbolgs. I welcome you, but you must be warned that my tribe reacts poorly to strangers.

BThese are trying times, and we can only trust those who choose to fight the corruption of the land alongside of us... and have proven themselves to us accordingly. Those who have not done so will be met with open hostility should they enter the Hold.

8510.name: The Alliance Needs More Arthas' Tears!
desc: Bring 20 Arthas' Tears to Sergeant Major Germaine at the airfield in Dun Morogh.

8534.name: Hive'Zora Scout Report
desc: Contact Cenarion Scout Azenel inside Hive'Zora and return the Hive'Zora Scout Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold. You must also bring Tactical Task Briefing VI in order to complete this quest.

8558.name: Sickle of Unyielding Strength
desc: Bring 1 Qiraji Spiked Hilt, 2 Alabaster Idols, 5 Crystal Scarabs and 5 Stone Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Spiked Hilt, 2 Alabaster Idols, 5 Crystal Scarabs and 5 Stone Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus. You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
details: The Qiraji and their servants wield items made with the rarest and finest materials: bones from gargantuan ancient creatures, gems from the depths of the earth, metals pure and strong.

BJust the sight of Qiraji artifacts fills me with an urge to practice my craft with their shattered and smelted pieces. Prove your allegiance to the Circle, $N, and I will make you a powerful weapon from the finest Qiraji materials.
completion: You've done well, $C. This is a masterwork hilt... the balance is perfect.
BTake your weapon, $N. Wield it with great confidence and vanquish our enemies!

8582.name: The Horde Needs Purple Lotus!
desc: Bring 20 Purple Lotus to Apothecary Jezel at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring 20 Purple Lotus to Apothecary Jezel at the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.
details: The purple lotus, $c, is a reagent in a great many potions, elixirs and oils, some of which will be of use to us at Ahn'Qiraj. We're going to need to create an immense number of those potions for the war effort. And I'm going to experiment to find more uses for the lotus as well. But to do all of that I'm going to need a great quantity of the flower.
BThat's where you come in. Go out into the field and collect up as many purple lotuses as you can. Is this something that you are willing to do for us?
completion: A commendable effort, $c. I will measure these specimens for their appropriate usage and note your contribution. The purple lotus will then need to be properly stored until I am ready for them. As for you, if you are still available I should imagine that I'll still need more purple lotus. Please check back with me in a moment.

8606.name: Decoy!
desc: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to travel to Winterspring and place the Bag of Gold at the drop off point documented by the booknappers.
objectives: Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris wants you to travel to Winterspring and place the Bag of Gold at the drop off point documented by the booknappers.
details: I've got it! Here's what we're going to do. I'm going to fill a sack up with rocks and you're going to make the drop. I know it said that I should make the delivery and I'm going to - sort of.
B<Narain looks you up and down.>
BYes, you will do just fine. Take this turban, robe, and sack of rocks and head to the drop off point in Winterspring.
BI've included everything you need in this special kit. When they show up to pick up the goods, snuff them out! That will teach them to mess with Narain!$B
completion: I think we may have underestimated these booknappers.

8630.name: Avenger's Pauldrons
desc: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of Life, 5 Crystal Scarabs and 5 Gold Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Neutral reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

8654.name: Primestone the Elder
completion: It is good to know the people of this land still pay homage to the olden races. I bid you well, $N, and offer you this token...

8678.name: Proudhorn the Elder
completion: Your spirit burns with life, young $C. I accept the homage you pay, and offer in return this token...

8702.name: Ring of Unspoken Names
desc: Bring 1 Qiraji Ceremonial Ring, 2 Jasper Idols, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
objectives: Bring 1 Qiraji Ceremonial Ring, 2 Jasper Idols, 5 Stone Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
details: The rings worn by the Qiraji lieutenants are rumored to grant them formidable abilities. The corrupted gems that adorn them could, in theory, be swapped out with more pure materials to create uncorrupted versions of the rings.
BThe gems that adorn Qiraji idols would work quite well, as their quality is superior.
BBring me the ring and idols and I'll create a powerful ring for you, $c.
completion: I will swap the gem on the ring for you. You'll find the effect is much more... agreeable.

8726.name: Brightspear the Elder
completion: The heavens, in their countless stars, hold answers to earthly mysteries, $N. Might, then, the wise, and the lucky, gaze up and find truth?

8750.name: The Path of the Protector

objectives.target: Signet Ring of the Bronze Dragonflight

completion: Your rise amongst the rank of the Brood is most impressive, $n. May you never stray from the path of the protector!

8774.name: Target: Hive'Regal Ambushers
desc: Kill 30 Hive'Regal Ambushers and report back to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus. You must also bring Combat Task Briefing VIII in order to complete this quest.

8798.name: A Yeti of Your Own
completion: Say! You know what?! You're an engineer too! So, since you helped me teach my friends a lesson, I'm going to teach you how to make your very own mechanical yeti! Now the fun can go on forever and ever, and you can scare whoever you want! Provided that you can scare up the components to make it that is.
BWhat do you say, $N? Do you want to learn the secret to making a mechanical yeti?

8870.name: The Lunar Festival
desc: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge. You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
objectives: Talk to the Lunar Festival Harbinger in the Mystic Ward of Ironforge. You can also talk to Lunar Festival Harbingers in other capital cities.
details: It's that time of the year, $N! The Cenarion Circle invites all denizens of Azeroth to partake in our celebration of the Lunar Festival. You will find the Lunar Festival Harbinger in this very city at a location marked by a blessed circle of moonlight. She can tell you more about the holiday.
completion: Welcome, $N. Are you here to join in the festivities?

8918.name: An Earnest Proposition
desc: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Bindings of Elements to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Acquire 15 Silithus Venom Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Bindings of Elements to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.$B
details: Hail, $c! I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world. Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.
BPerform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.
BI'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus. Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
completion: Ah, yes. That old goblin shall be quite happy with this blood.
BThose bindings were part of a larger armor set. If you're interested in providing me with further assistance I'd be willing to consider parting with the rest of it.

8942.name: Just Compensation
desc: Bring a Cord of Elements and a set of Gauntlets of Elements to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.
objectives: Bring a Cord of Elements and a set of Gauntlets of Elements to Mokvar in Orgrimmar.$B
details: You've proven to be a very reliable individual, $N. As much as I trust that you'll help me through this predicament, it would be wise of me to reward you according to your performance.
BFor now I will exchange your belt and gauntlets. If we both see this through I shall make the rest of the pieces available to you.
completion: Our agreement remains in place. Just remember, this is but a taste of what awaits you. Free me of this cursed fate and I will reward you with items of truly great power.

8966.name: The Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
desc: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Mor Grayhoof and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
objectives: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Mor Grayhoof and slay him. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
details: My friend, Mor Grayhoof, was the first to fall victim to possession of a piece of Lord Valthalak's amulet, and the corrupting spirit fragment that it contains. After stealing Valthalak's spellbook and amulet, we fled for our lives from the upper portion of Blackrock Spire. Along the way, Mor fell into the lower portion of the spire.
BLater, we discovered that he survived the fall, only to be captured and tortured by War Master Voone. A few spectral assassins snuck in and slew him right in front of Voone.
completion: You have done a great thing, $N. One spirit rests in peace, but there is still much work to be done before we can put all of this behind us.

BUnfortunately, I do not know the location of the one who died with the right piece of the amulet in their possession. But do not fear; in life I was a dabbler in the art of divination, so I have another task for you, which is going to enable us to ferret out the final piece.

8990.name: The Right Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet
desc: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Isalien and slay her. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
objectives: Use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth the spirit of Isalien and slay her. Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain with the recombined Lord Valthalak's Amulet and the Brazier of Beckoning.
details: It became known to us in later days, as we were doing what we could ourselves to survive, that Isalien, a night elf priestess of our company, had gone to the night elvic ancestral city, now known as Dire Maul. From what we gathered, she went there both for personal reasons and also to unlock the secrets of the piece of the amulet that she had in her possession.
BShe didn't quite make it, though. Word got back to us that she was ambushed at the Shrine of Eldretharr by Alzzin the Wildshaper and his forces.
completion: Thank you, $N, for putting Isalien's spirit to rest. Now, perhaps, she will find peace with her goddess. And, we have the reassembled amulet, as well! But we still have the hardest test ahead of us.
BIn order for the brazier to be attuned to calling forth Lord Valthalak, there are a few more items that need to be gathered and brought back to me here.

9014.name: Saving the Best for Last
desc: Give Mokvar your Magister's Crown and Magister's Robes.
objectives: Give Mokvar your Magister's Crown and Magister's Robes.
details: A truly amazing story, $N! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past.
BAs to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
completion: I will truly miss you, $N. There is a debt that I owe you, which I may never be able to repay.
BEnjoy your new head and chest armor. May it protect you for a long time to come, and help you to achieve even greater honor!

9038.name: Dreadnaught Pauldrons
desc: Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Dreadnaught Pauldrons if you bring him the following items: 1 Desecrated Pauldrons, 12 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 2 Arcanite Bars and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.

9086.name: Dreamwalker Tunic
desc: Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Dreamwalker Tunic if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Tunic, 25 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 6 Cured Rugged Hides and 2 Nexus Crystals.

9110.name: Plagueheart Bindings
desc: Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Plagueheart Bindings if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Bindings, 6 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 1 Arcane Crystal and 1 Nexus Crystal.

9182.name: Craftsman's Writ - Huge Thorium Battleaxe
desc: Deliver 3 Huge Thorium Battleaxes and the Craftsman's Writ - Huge Thorium Battleaxe - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

9206.name: Craftsman's Writ - Lightning Eel
desc: Deliver 30 Lightning Eel and the Craftsman's Writ - Lightning Eel - to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.

9230.name: Ramaladni's Icy Grasp
desc: Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants you to bring him 1 Frozen Rune, 1 Blue Sapphire and 1 Arcanite Bar.
objectives: Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands wants you to bring him 1 Frozen Rune, 1 Blue Sapphire and 1 Arcanite Bar.$B
details: Fixing this band may prove to be quite challenging, $N. You see, it was made from the very runes that form inside Scourge structures - like Naxxramas. Additional materials are also required but your main concern should be getting those frozen runes. Bring me what I need and I will restore the ring to its former glory.
completion: Ramaladni himself couldn't have done better! Here is the ring, as promised.

9302.name: Missive from the Front
desc: Take the Crumpled Missive to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
objectives: Take the Crumpled Missive to the Keeper of the Rolls at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
details: You found this letter on one of the many Scourge minions you've slain. From its appearance and smell, it has been with the undead for some time. Perhaps someone at Light's Hope Chapel would be interested in examining it further...
completion: How tragic. These words, clearly meant for someone the soldier loved, never made it to their destination. The events detailed happened years ago; I'm not sure if the intended recipient still lives.
BThere is hope yet, however. With the names and information he gives, I might be able to locate the family! It will take some research, but the librarian in Stormwind owes me a favor...
BThank you for bringing this to me. With your help, we may be able to grant someone peace of mind at least.

9326.name: Stealing the Undercity's Flame
desc: Return the Flame of the Undercity to the Festival Loremaster.
objectives: Return the Flame of the Undercity to the Festival Loremaster.
details: This flame, stolen from the ruins above the Undercity, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Loremaster might know more...
completion: Hm... what a strange fire! It is subdued, nearly smoldering, but the heat is intense. And you received this from the Undercity, you say? Fascinating. With the flames of all three cities, who knows what we could accomplish?

9422.name: Scouring the Desert
desc: Find and deliver Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor then speak with General Kirika at the Horde encampment near Hive'Regal.
objectives: Find and deliver Silithyst to the Silithyst Extractor then speak with General Kirika at the Horde encampment near Hive'Regal.
details: For some time now, we have been tapping the crystal resources of the Silithus desert. The only dangers we faced were from the creatures that made this place their home and the oppressive sand and dust and heat.
BBut now the Alliance seems to have caught on to what we have found here. It is now a race between us to capture the natural resources, and keep them from the other.
BI need every set of hands that is available. I hope I have yours.
completion: You've done well, $N. These resources will be added to our stockpiles, and every bit is to our gain and our enemy's loss.

objectives: Heal 5 Injured Deathguard with your Holy Light ability.
*Injured Deathguard healed (5)
details: I am proud to welcome another newly risen paladin to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others.

The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.
progress: Mastery of the light will return, in time.

objectives: Slay 8 Pesky Cirrusflies in Thendal Grove.
*Pesky Cirrusfly slain (8)
details: One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove.
Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the swarm is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.
progress: Such pests cannot be allowed to find root in our peaceful grove. An infestation can quickly grow dangerous if left unchecked.

objectives: Talk to someone in Stormwind Intelligence about acquiring a remote detonator.
details: I assume you want a "controlled" explosion? Not as much fun, but a good choice if you want to keep all your limbs.
I'm afraid I don't have a remote detonator - why don't you go check with the sneaky folks down at Stormwind Intelligence? They should be able to find us something.

objectives: Speak to Raan Wildwind near Shen'dar Village.
details: More and more adventurers like yourself have been seeking glory and fortune outside of the safety of Thendal Grove. There's one such adventurer who has made a camp outside of Shen'dar Village, along the road leading southwest out of Thendal Grove.
Seek him out and see what you can learn from him that may help you in your own travels.

objectives: Punish 5 Deathguards for Executor Zygand.
*Deathguards motivated (5)
*Executor's Motivator (provided)
details: You are not a member of the Deathguard, and therefore have yet to disappoint me.
As a reward for your lack of incompetence, you shall be rewarded with punishing those that have demonstrated such talents in excess.
Swiftly now--, is it?--or I shall add your name to my ledger for someone else's reward.
